incidents.observed_error: The second candidate was syntactically typed but systemically misbound: the producer targeted an alias relation for an outbox operation, update effects could be empty, trigger row images crossed relations, derivations omitted sources and closed profile names concealed rather than expressed computation.
incidents.detection_method: Sol parsed and structurally validated the artifact, then performed an operand-level audit with two bounded independent read-only analyses. The candidate was rejected before sealing or staging.

correction.action: The misbound candidate was preserved only as negative evidence. A fresh builder now emits all twenty-two programs from closed operands, and the validator plus nineteen-class hostile packet rejects wrong targets, omitted effects, illegal row images, unproduced values and opaque operations.
correction.prevention_control: Typed syntax is insufficient: acceptance rederives effects and graphs, compares the exact body AST envelope and runs relation-, source-, trigger-, lock- and authority-mutation attacks after resealing evidence.

incidents.expected_invariant: The exact post-commit five-source pre-worker-dispatch receipt must pass before any cohort worker begins task work.
incidents.observed_error: Sol spawned three bounded cohort agents before generating the exact post-commit dispatch receipt. Sol immediately paused all three before task work and no owned file changed until the corrected receipt passed.
incidents.detection_method: The orchestrator recognized the ordering error at dispatch time, paused every worker and verified the shared workspace remained unchanged before constructing the receipt.

correction.action: The agents remained paused while a fresh five-source receipt was generated and corrected; only its passing successor authorised resumption.
correction.prevention_control: Generate and inspect the exact-head pre-worker-dispatch receipt before calling the agent spawn primitive; pause and audit immediately if ordering is violated.

incidents.expected_invariant: A receipt's expected task HEAD must be copied from the exact forty-character git rev-parse result and independently compared with Git rather than trusted as a self-reported evidence string.
incidents.observed_error: The first corrected runtime state named an incorrect full candidate SHA, yet the receipt passed because that evidence string was not Git-verified. Sol detected the mismatch before resuming workers and replaced it with d2ed77c177f1f1dbb217984caea904732903df9c.
incidents.detection_method: Sol compared the receipt text with a fresh git rev-parse HEAD, found the discrepancy and reran the receipt after correcting the runtime state.

correction.action: The same candidate remained unchanged. The runtime state was corrected to the exact Git HEAD, the five-source receipt reran and passed, and only then were workers resumed.
correction.prevention_control: Every dispatch receipt must independently resolve and compare Git HEAD; an expected-head evidence string cannot establish its own truth.

incidents.expected_invariant: A detached exact-head verifier checkout must use a destination short enough for every versioned path, complete successfully and pass the clean-worktree preflight before reviewer dispatch.
incidents.observed_error: The first attempt used a descriptive review-worktree destination that made an already-versioned evidence filename exceed the Windows path limit. Git reported Filename too long and could not reset the index; no usable or registered worktree remained.
incidents.detection_method: The git worktree command failed before dispatch; Sol then verified that the requested destination did not exist, the path was not registered and the immutable candidate HEAD remained unchanged.

correction.action: The failed destination remained absent and unregistered. The distinct successor uses the established short rNN destination while binding the same full candidate SHA and reruns the clean-worktree preflight before dispatch.
correction.prevention_control: Windows verifier worktrees use the short rNN root naming pattern; descriptive tranche identity belongs in the review packet and receipt rather than the filesystem destination.

incidents.expected_invariant: The replacement body architecture must independently prove the complete coordinator transition state machine, one internally consistent non-consumed retention census, current-transaction-only non-temporal effects and exact recovery/signature/privilege/enum closure without relying on a self-generated baseline equality check.
incidents.observed_error: The committed candidate passed its local suite but the fresh exact-head veto found four under-closed semantic surfaces. Resealed owner privilege widening, retention enum widening, producer owner substitution and removal of the producer event-membership assertion were admitted by both semantic and structural validation.
incidents.detection_method: A fresh read-only independent reviewer inspected the exact twenty-four-path packet at f51f5b65dd77d9282e5325a5e4f17edd872d14df, ran the prescribed passing checks, challenged semantic closure with four independently resealed mutations and returned one revision_required decision while leaving the candidate unchanged.

correction.action: The exact candidate remains rejected. Sol froze a four-part replacement contract covering coordinator and retention semantics, current-XID transaction fencing, independent scalar and privilege closure, and hostile tests that do not depend on regenerated-baseline equality.
correction.prevention_control: A body-architecture candidate cannot be accepted until a fresh exact-head veto independently demonstrates semantic rejection of resealed privilege, enum, signature, proof-removal, coordinator, retention and transaction-scope mutations after all deterministic checks pass.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every orchestrator runtime state must enumerate every worker-pool resource required by the active Ariadne settings, including a required pool with zero active or stale instances.
incidents.observed_error: The first exact-veto recovery precommit runtime state listed only the native recovery pool and omitted the configured deepseek-flash-workers inventory. The preflight failed closed with worker_slot_inventory_missing before staging or commit.
incidents.detection_method: The generated receipt returned revision_required with the exact missing worker-slot reason; Sol preserved it, added the required zero-instance inventory in a distinct v3 runtime state and obtained a passing receipt.

correction.action: The failed receipt remains immutable. The distinct v3 runtime state includes both the required deepseek-flash-workers inventory and native recovery inventory with empty active/stale lists and produces one passing five-source receipt.
correction.prevention_control: Copy the complete configured worker-slot inventory into every runtime state even when a required pool has zero instances; treat zero inventory as evidence rather than omission.

incidents.expected_invariant: A repository module that imports the scripts package must be invoked or imported with the repository root on Python's module path, following the existing AER-0058 prevention control.
incidents.observed_error: While inspecting generator command interfaces, Sol invoked the schema module by filesystem path. It failed closed at import with ModuleNotFoundError before executing a generator, reading a candidate or writing any artifact.
incidents.detection_method: The command returned a non-zero status and exact import error inline; Git state remained unchanged and the distinct correction imported the module through the repository package path successfully.

correction.action: The failed invocation is preserved. Sol imported the schema module through the repository package path, confirmed build_schema was available and made no repository write.
correction.prevention_control: Invoke import-dependent scripts as python -m scripts.<module> when they expose a module CLI, or import their public API from the repository root; never execute them by filesystem path.

incidents.expected_invariant: After the recurrent package-path failure AER-0066, the import-dependent artifact builder must be invoked through python -m from the repository root.
incidents.observed_error: Sol again invoked an import-dependent scripts module by filesystem path. The builder completed only its in-memory contract step, then failed closed while importing the schema module before either generated artifact was opened or written.
incidents.detection_method: The command returned ModuleNotFoundError inline. The distinct repository-root package-module invocation then wrote both generated artifacts and exited successfully.

correction.action: The failed command is preserved. Sol invoked the builder as python -m scripts.raisa_provider_free_unmounted_durability_function_trigger_body_architecture_builder from the repository root; the validated contract and schema were then generated successfully.
correction.prevention_control: The direct-path exception is removed for this tranche: every Python file under scripts is invoked as a package module unless a recorded preflight proves it has no package imports on every execution path.

incidents.expected_invariant: The historical API Spine regression cohort should collect and pass on the recovery source HEAD before it is used as corroborating evidence for an unrelated unmounted architecture descendant.
incidents.observed_error: One API Spine integration module could not collect because it imports the removed _BERNIE_SESSION_STORE. After that file was explicitly isolated, 535 tests collected and 530 passed; five stale preflight or inventory assertions disagreed with already-present idempotency headers, GraphQL resolvers, OpenAPI command paths and SDL inventory.
incidents.detection_method: Sol ran all fifty-eight API Spine test files serially, preserved the collection traceback, reran the remaining fifty-seven files, collected the exact 535-test population and verified every implicated app, API-document and test path was byte-unchanged from recovery source HEAD 7ad40bd337ac6433bd6cc84653dd5883679ed13b.

correction.action: The baseline defect is contained as non-candidate evidence. This tranche makes no app, router, OpenAPI, GraphQL SDL, idempotency-index or historical-test repair and relies on its passing architecture-specific suites plus scoped API Spine invariants.
correction.prevention_control: Future cross-programme regression gates must run a source-HEAD baseline preflight and separate pre-existing collection or expectation drift from candidate-caused regressions before using the suite as acceptance evidence.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every design label naming the current deterministic candidate digest must equal the builder-derived contract and generated schema digest before exact-HEAD reviewer admission.
incidents.observed_error: The rebuilt contract and schema bound digest sha256:8871663b121dedff089b7517406f8223a3df2153bce66716d624b2f321e20dde while the design still labelled rejected predecessor digest sha256:631773f9112e7804f5e2ea15b04d4cd4cb4c699502d3491b516d57d14e6f35d5 as current.
incidents.detection_method: Sol compared the successful builder module --check output, generated contract and schema digest with the design before dispatching the fresh reviewer; the mismatch was corrected before the prepared review worktree was used.

correction.action: The design now names the builder-derived rebuilt contract digest. The unused review worktree must be replaced by a fresh exact-HEAD worktree after the correction is committed.
correction.prevention_control: Before reviewer worktree creation, compare every current-candidate digest label against the builder --check output and generated contract/schema digest values.

incidents.expected_invariant: A passing replacement must make receipt replay conflict-safe and integrity-rederived, registration create or reload its head and compare the complete baseline, retention join every aggregate proof to the exact non-consumed generation census, and critical signature and trigger fields fail independently of canonical section equality.
incidents.observed_error: The fresh exact-HEAD veto found three P1 gaps and one P2 gap despite 128/128 passing tests: receipt replay ignored retained conflicts and did not rederive the receipt digest; registration had no head insert and compared only the generation row on replay; retention aggregate sets and key count were not generation-identity complete; and owner, security-definer, volatility, timing and deferrability mutations emitted only normative_section_mismatch.
incidents.detection_method: A fresh read-only reviewer inspected exactly twenty-eight allowlisted paths at 5ea59e14184b26dfa0b8d3a6ebaf28b39c04fb9d, ran the complete passing packet, challenged R1 through R4 directly and returned one revision_required decision with exact unchanged HEAD and clean worktree postflight.

correction.action: The exact candidate remains rejected. Sol froze R5A conflict-safe receipt replay, R5B complete registration head/baseline semantics, R5C identity-joined set and per-generation key coverage, and R5D field-independent signature/declaration validation before replacement implementation.
correction.prevention_control: No body candidate advances on passing generated tests alone. Fresh veto must directly challenge replay conflict and digest derivation, every registration baseline member, consumed and duplicate-key retention counterexamples, and field-specific signature/trigger mutations after resealing.

incidents.expected_invariant: Reviewer environment controls must use valid tool-specific Boolean spellings while preserving the exact read-only command and worktree boundary.
incidents.observed_error: The reviewer set RUFF_NO_CACHE=1. Ruff rejected the invalid Boolean spelling before analysis and made no repository change.
incidents.detection_method: The reviewer preserved the rejected invocation in its terminal report, reran with RUFF_NO_CACHE=true, obtained a passing result and verified exact unchanged HEAD plus empty git status.

correction.action: The invalid invocation was discarded. The reviewer reran the exact Ruff path set with RUFF_NO_CACHE=true, passed, and completed clean exact-HEAD postflight.
correction.prevention_control: Reviewer packets and follow-up commands use literal supported Boolean values true or false for Ruff environment controls; numeric truthy spellings are not used.

incidents.expected_invariant: A reviewer must transcribe every allowlisted Ruff path exactly so the prescribed read-only check runs against the complete intended candidate surface.
incidents.observed_error: The reviewer first transcribed one underscore-delimited Python filename with hyphens. Ruff returned E902 because that nonexistent path could not be opened; no candidate file was analysed or changed by that failed invocation.
incidents.detection_method: The reviewer preserved the E902 result, corrected the path to the packet's exact filename, reran the complete Ruff path set successfully, and verified unchanged exact HEAD plus an empty worktree status.

correction.action: The invalid invocation was discarded and the complete exact packet path set passed on a fresh invocation without changing HEAD or worktree state.
correction.prevention_control: Reviewer commands must be copied from the exact packet or programmatically checked for path existence before tool execution; manually transformed path spelling is forbidden.

incidents.expected_invariant: A passing candidate must keep retained receipt and terminal replay source-independent on every control-flow path, independently prove the complete committed lifecycle packet before appending or replaying a recovery anchor, and make duplicate set-key pairs structurally invalid.
incidents.observed_error: The fresh exact-HEAD veto found two P1 gaps and one P2 gap despite 192/192 passing tests: coordinator replay inherited an unconditional source outbox read; recovery-anchor append/replay copied generation/checkpoint fields without lifecycle, receipt, audit or key proof; and the two set-key-pair schema branches lacked uniqueItems true.
incidents.detection_method: A fresh read-only reviewer inspected the exact allowlisted candidate at 5a3c5b5118f80153d545bf30ae9db99acb187cd7, ran the complete passing packet, directly challenged source-independent control-flow effects, anchor evidence derivation and duplicate structural key pairs, then returned revision_required with exact unchanged HEAD and clean worktree postflight.

correction.action: The exact candidate remains rejected. Sol froze R6A path-local source-independent replay, R6B complete independently derived recovery-anchor proof and R6C structural key-pair uniqueness before replacement implementation.
correction.prevention_control: No replacement advances on passing generated tests alone. Focused hostile tests and fresh veto must trace per-path relation effects, substitute or omit every anchor evidence class and independently validate duplicate key pairs against the generated Draft 2020-12 schema.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every pre-worker-dispatch runtime state must inventory the complete managed worker-slot set from orchestrator_requirements.yaml, including deepseek-flash-workers even when no external DeepSeek transport is selected.
incidents.observed_error: The first R6 implementation predispatch state listed three descriptive native lane resources but omitted the required managed deepseek-flash-workers inventory. The preflight correctly returned revision_required and prohibited dispatch.
incidents.detection_method: scripts.ariadne_orchestrator_preflight emitted worker_slot_inventory_missing:deepseek-flash-workers before any worker was dispatched. Sol added the empty required inventory and a distinct v2 receipt passed with worker_dispatch_permitted true.

correction.action: No dispatch followed the failed receipt. The corrected runtime state inventories deepseek-flash-workers with no active or stale instance and the distinct v2 predispatch receipt passes.
correction.prevention_control: Every dispatch runtime state starts with every managed_resource_id copied verbatim from orchestrator_requirements.yaml before any descriptive native-lane inventory is added.

incidents.expected_invariant: The body architecture and every recovery must preserve the immutable parent's lifecycle branch constraint: DECISION has a non-null source position and null key interval, while KEY_ROTATION has null source position and a present ordered key interval.
incidents.observed_error: The first R6 worktree candidate and the initial R6B recovery wording treated KEY_ROTATION lifecycle source_position as the unchanged checkpoint position. The generated candidate therefore contradicted the parent's exact KEY_ROTATION source_position IS NULL branch even though the checkpoint position itself should remain unchanged.
incidents.detection_method: The bounded read-only anchor challenger identified the mismatch. Sol independently reproduced it at the immutable parent contract's exact lifecycle branch constraint and rejected uncommitted candidate digest sha256:49db11e74a46d1056e694614a970037cf021e174d71114f5262e950b9075b01f before acceptance or commit.

correction.action: The candidate remains rejected. The corrected third recovery requires the rotation producer and anchor proof to use NULL lifecycle source position, prove unchanged checkpoint position from the preceding anchor and validate latest-prior-audit continuity across rotations.
correction.prevention_control: Every child body branch must be mechanically compared with every immutable parent check-constraint branch, not only with prose and digest formulas, before generation or exact-veto dispatch.

incidents.expected_invariant: A bounded read-only architecture challenger must finish with exactly one requested terminal RESULT after preserving its smallest confirmed finding.
incidents.observed_error: The challenger delivered the material KEY_ROTATION parent-constraint finding but did not return a terminal result after repeated bounded conclusion requests. Sol interrupted it twice and did not attribute acceptance authority or a fabricated terminal decision.
incidents.detection_method: The collaboration harness continued to report the challenger as running after its finding and after explicit conclude-now messages. Sol preserved only the exact delivered finding and independently reproduced it against the parent contract.

correction.action: The nonterminal challenge was stopped. Its confirmed finding is preserved without overclaim, Sol reproduced it independently, and a later fresh exact-HEAD veto remains mandatory for acceptance.
correction.prevention_control: Read-only challenge packets use a short fixed evidence budget and must emit the terminal result immediately after the first material parent-contract contradiction is reproduced; additional hardening questions return as nonblocking notes.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every terminal coordinator control-flow path must acquire each required lock exactly once in a contiguous strictly increasing ordinal sequence while preserving replay-local reads and current-anchor proof.
incidents.observed_error: The first integrated R6 coordinator candidate acquired a new current-anchor lock after an existing primary lock and then reacquired the anchor inside rebase descendants. The deterministic builder rejected the uncommitted candidate with lock_ordinal_duplicate and lock_ordinal_sequence before it could be treated as evidence.
incidents.detection_method: The source-generated contract validator traced every terminal path during the first post-integration build and failed closed on both lock invariants. Sol rejected that worktree state, moved the single current-anchor lock ahead of primary or conflict admission and made every descendant rebase reuse the already-held anchor.

correction.action: The rejected state was not committed. Primary and conflict routes now lock the current anchor at ordinal four and their admission row at ordinal five; rebase descendants reuse that held anchor, while admission-missing paths take one branch-local anchor lock and replay-only paths remain anchor-free.
correction.prevention_control: Every coordinator repair must rebuild through the path-sensitive validator before tests, and hostile tests must assert both branch-local relation reads and exact lock ordinals for primary, conflict, rebase, receipt-replay and terminal-replay paths.

incidents.expected_invariant: Windows verifier worktrees for this repository must use the established short rNN destination so every versioned path can be checked out before exact-HEAD preflight and review dispatch.
incidents.observed_error: The first R6 final-review checkout repeated the known descriptive-destination error. Several already-versioned paths exceeded the Windows path limit and Git could not reset the index; no usable worktree was registered at that destination.
incidents.detection_method: The worktree command returned Filename too long before dispatch. Sol verified that the requested destination was absent and unregistered, retained the unchanged candidate branch, then checked it out at short destination r34 and passed exact-HEAD clean-worktree preflight.

correction.action: No review followed the failed checkout. The same exact candidate branch was checked out at r34, where independent preflight proved the full expected HEAD, codex/review branch prefix and tracked-clean state before reviewer dispatch.
correction.prevention_control: On Windows this repository must allocate every new verifier worktree from the next available short rNN destination before constructing any descriptive path; tranche identity belongs only in the branch, packet and receipt.

incidents.expected_invariant: Immutable parent invariant anchor_fences_next_transition_v1 requires that no key rotation begin until the latest independently reverified recovery anchor exactly matches the locked checkpoint and generation.
incidents.observed_error: Committed candidate 0bfd3e7545dfa1a7431f856b5eaf2aac32a9292d locked the current recovery anchor but did not compare its checkpoint state, contiguous position, observation digest, checkpoint-integrity digest or seven controlling digests with the locked checkpoint and generation before using its anchor digest to author the next rotation revision.
incidents.detection_method: Fresh exact-HEAD independent veto constructed a stale-anchor counterexample at the correct locator and revision: checkpoint position 10, stale anchor position 9, prior key ending at 10 and proposed interval 11-12 satisfied the existing assertions and allowed the stale anchor digest to seed the rotation.

correction.action: Candidate 0bfd3e7545dfa1a7431f856b5eaf2aac32a9292d remains immutable rejected evidence. The fourth recovery freezes one F_ANCHOR assertion immediately after the anchor lock and before the prior-key lock or any effect, comparing all four checkpoint fields and seven controlling generation digests.
correction.prevention_control: For every body named by a parent invariant, candidate-independent hostile tests must prove each required field-level equality and its execution order rather than accepting locator, row lock or aggregate digest presence as equivalent evidence.

incidents.expected_invariant: A native worker predispatch runtime state must use the approved pre_worker_dispatch continuation event and must not declare an assigned agent without a corresponding workspace receipt.
incidents.observed_error: The first R7 worker predispatch state used the unapproved continuation event pre_dispatch and listed durability_r5_validator in assigned_agent_ids without a workspace receipt. The preflight returned revision_required and prohibited dispatch.
incidents.detection_method: scripts.ariadne_orchestrator_preflight returned continuation_event_missing_or_unapproved and workspace_receipt_missing:durability_r5_validator before any follow-up task was sent. Sol preserved the failed envelope and generated a distinct v2 state with pre_worker_dispatch, empty assigned_agent_ids and complete worker-slot inventory.

correction.action: No worker dispatch followed the failed receipt. The distinct v2 runtime state uses pre_worker_dispatch, leaves assigned_agent_ids empty before assignment, inventories the managed and native slots and produced a passing receipt before the follow-up task was sent.
correction.prevention_control: Copy the approved continuation event from a passing native-worker predispatch receipt and leave assigned_agent_ids empty unless an actual workspace receipt is already present; descriptive lane availability belongs in adapter evidence and worker_slots.

incidents.expected_invariant: A fresh exact-HEAD Antigravity verifier must return one schema-constrained pass or revision_required receipt, or fail with explicit contained evidence while leaving the candidate unchanged.
incidents.observed_error: The first R7 final-veto process ran a long CPU-active local test subprocess, then agy exited with status 1, empty stderr and no structured verifier output or ordinary review receipt. No review decision exists.
incidents.detection_method: The wrapper raised Antigravity transport failed (1). Two read-only liveness checks had observed the same child test process increase from 779.78125 to 1608.953125 CPU seconds; postflight proved exact HEAD and a clean worktree, and the expected output receipt was absent.

correction.action: The failed attempt remains preserved without a fabricated verdict. One distinct fresh project reviewed the same immutable candidate using the already-completed 339-test Sol packet, a bounded 44-test R7A command set and independent counterexamples; it returned one schema-constrained pass with no P0-P3 finding and unchanged clean exact-HEAD postflight.
correction.prevention_control: Keep complete deterministic acceptance under Sol, then give external exact-HEAD vetoes a focused risk-derived command packet and independent semantic challenges; do not make a long duplicate full-suite child process the only path to a verifier decision.

incidents.expected_invariant: The canonical Continuity graph and its closed JSON Schema must agree on every evidence property already emitted by accepted continuity updaters.
incidents.observed_error: The canonical graph already carried optional artifacts arrays on eight accepted nodes, but the evidence schema forbade the artifacts property, so full JSON Schema validation failed when the R7 node used the same established updater shape.
incidents.detection_method: The completed continuity-bound packet failed tests/test_ariadne_continuity_engine.py and reported artifacts as the exact unexpected evidence property; read-only baseline inspection proved eight pre-R7 canonical nodes already contained that property while the schema contained no matching definition.

correction.action: The closed evidence schema now permits an optional artifacts array using the existing safe repository-path definition. Required inherited contract evidence classes remain unchanged, and the complete canonical graph passes JSON Schema validation.
correction.prevention_control: Every continuity updater property must be represented in the closed graph schema and the canonical full-graph JSON Schema test must run in each continuity closeout packet.

incidents.expected_invariant: The general Compass report test must track the canonical current accepted terminal node rather than a superseded historical current-position literal.
incidents.observed_error: The general Compass test still expected the durability state-machine rehearsal even though the pre-R7 canonical Compass had already advanced to the migration-and-transaction architecture, so it rejected the new valid body-architecture terminal node.
incidents.detection_method: The completed continuity-bound packet failed tests/test_ariadne_compass.py at the exact current-position assertion; baseline readback showed the assertion was already stale relative to the pre-R7 canonical map.

correction.action: The general Compass report test now binds the accepted function-and-trigger-body terminal node, while the tranche-specific continuity test independently fixes exact graph and map revisions and the current node.
correction.prevention_control: Every Compass advancement must run both the general report suite and a tranche-specific exact current-position test so stale historical literals fail and are corrected in the same closeout.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every independent-review predispatch runtime state must use the approved pre_worker_dispatch continuation event and pass Ariadne preflight before a verifier is launched.
incidents.observed_error: The first plan-challenge runtime state used the unapproved continuation event pre_dispatch. Ariadne preflight returned revision_required with continuation_event_missing_or_unapproved and prohibited launch.
incidents.detection_method: The preflight receipt rejected the state before any Antigravity project was launched; Sol preserved that receipt, created a distinct state using pre_worker_dispatch and obtained a passing receipt before review dispatch.

correction.action: No verifier followed the rejected state. A distinct runtime state used pre_worker_dispatch and passed the full five-source Ariadne preflight before the review was launched.
correction.prevention_control: Copy continuation_event only from the approved event vocabulary or a passing current predispatch receipt; never shorten pre_worker_dispatch to a descriptive alias.

incidents.expected_invariant: A verifier challenging whether a lowering plan is mechanically complete must report the exact immutable opcode populations and must not invent a failure SQLSTATE absent from the accepted registry.
incidents.observed_error: The schema-constrained review returned pass while reporting 21 declared instruction opcodes and 33 declared expression opcodes instead of 22 and 34, and asserted that unique-race mismatch re-raises registered 42000/P0001 even though neither value appears in the durability failure registry.
incidents.detection_method: Sol traversed the exact body contract at the unchanged candidate HEAD and reproduced 22 declared/21 observed instruction opcodes with only DERIVE_BINDING absent, 34 declared/34 observed expression opcodes, and F_CARDINALITY/CF004 as the existing value-free cardinality outcome. The false claims directly overlap the requested completeness and unique-race challenge.

correction.action: The first pass remains preserved but not admitted. Sol invoked the plan recovery lease, froze exact opcode populations and F_CARDINALITY/CF004 handling, and one fresh exact-HEAD replacement challenge reproduced the corrected contract facts and returned pass with no P0-P3 finding.
correction.prevention_control: Critical verifier population and registry claims must be mechanically reconciled against the immutable JSON before acceptance; a discrepancy touching the challenged mechanism invalidates the verdict rather than being treated as harmless prose.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every pre_worker_dispatch state must inventory all required configured worker resource IDs, including inactive reserved implementation capacity, before any verifier or worker launch.
incidents.observed_error: The first replacement-veto predispatch state inventoried the Gemini verifier slot but omitted the required deepseek-flash-workers slot. Ariadne preflight returned revision_required with worker_slot_inventory_missing:deepseek-flash-workers.
incidents.detection_method: The generic orchestrator preflight rejected the state before Antigravity launch. Sol preserved the failed state and receipt, added the required inactive slot and obtained a distinct passing v2 receipt before launching the replacement review.

correction.action: No review launched from the rejected state. The corrected runtime state inventories both deepseek-flash-workers and gemini-verifier with empty instance lists and produced a passing receipt before the successful fresh review.
correction.prevention_control: Generate predispatch worker_slots from the configured required resource inventory, including inactive reserved lanes, rather than only the resource selected for the immediate launch.

incidents.expected_invariant: A worker predispatch state must use the configured adapter probe method for every selected transport and pass Ariadne preflight before launch.
incidents.observed_error: The first DeepSeek implementation predispatch state used an invalid probe method for deepseek_via_claude_code_bare. Ariadne returned revision_required with adapter_probe_method_invalid and prohibited dispatch.
incidents.detection_method: The generic orchestrator preflight rejected the state before any DeepSeek process was launched; a distinct corrected state used the configured method and passed before dispatch.

correction.action: No worker followed the rejected receipt. The v2 state used the configured deepseek_claude_cli_observation method and passed the five-source preflight before launch.
correction.prevention_control: Copy adapter method identifiers from transport_adapters.yaml or a current passing receipt; never infer them from the adapter ID.

incidents.expected_invariant: A candidate_ready worker result must satisfy the accepted inert-renderer clauses and must not describe invalid PostgreSQL lowering as complete merely because its authored tests pass.
incidents.observed_error: The worker returned candidate_ready after 41 tests, but Sol review found non-exact cardinality handling, comment-only isolation assertions, invalid bounded DELETE syntax, invalid or dishonest ARRAY/ROW and complete-set lowering, and incomplete owner, digest and recognizer closure.
incidents.detection_method: Sol inspected the six owned files and rendered bytes against the accepted plan rather than accepting the worker test summary; the concrete defects were reproduced and supplied to one bounded same-lane correction.

correction.action: The first candidate was not committed or accepted. One bounded correction repaired the exact defects and added hostile regressions before the candidate was reassessed.
correction.prevention_control: Candidate-ready admission requires source and rendered-byte review against every acceptance clause; worker-owned tests are evidence but never self-acceptance.

incidents.expected_invariant: A corrected candidate_ready result must remain subject to independent PostgreSQL-representability review and must not claim no blocker while emitting known-invalid dependency, trigger, ownership or row-image forms.
incidents.observed_error: The corrected worker returned candidate_ready and no blockers after 58 focused tests, but Sol found nullable empty-set counts, policies before their helper, invalid deferrable trigger grammar, unclosed object owners, six unrepresentable OLD.xmin references, non-producer appointment rejection and a raw unknown-lock fallback.
incidents.detection_method: Sol performed a source and rendered-byte audit against PostgreSQL-16 semantics and the ordinary-writer boundary; every defect was reproduced despite the passing worker suite, so the bounded correction was rejected.

correction.action: The DeepSeek lane was closed without another correction. Sol froze one exact recovery, obtained a fresh plan veto, implemented eight fragment-sealed transforms, passed 62 merged tests and obtained a fresh exact-commit Gemini pass with no P0-P3 finding.
correction.prevention_control: Before candidate admission, mechanically test PostgreSQL null, dependency, trigger-grammar, system-column and ownership semantics in addition to the renderer's internal contract tests.

incidents.expected_invariant: The verifier worktree preflight expected_head must be the exact full git rev-parse identity, never a display abbreviation.
incidents.observed_error: The recovery-plan review preflight received d7757e19 instead of the full candidate identity and correctly returned revision_required for an exact-HEAD mismatch.
incidents.detection_method: The local preflight rejected the short hash before any provider or model call; rerunning with the full Git identity produced the preserved passing receipt.

correction.action: No review followed the failed check. The exact full HEAD was read and the canonical preflight passed before dispatch.
correction.prevention_control: Populate verifier expected_head only from the literal output of git rev-parse HEAD in the target worktree.

incidents.expected_invariant: The verifier worktree preflight expected_head must be copied from exact git output and must never be guessed from a short commit prefix.
incidents.observed_error: The implementation review preflight was given a fabricated full hash sharing the 46e16622 prefix rather than the actual 46e16622471a192353cb82a33acf301dc2cfb7aa, and correctly returned revision_required.
incidents.detection_method: The local preflight emitted the exact mismatch before any Gemini call. Sol then read git rev-parse HEAD, reran successfully and dispatched only from the passing receipt.

correction.action: No review followed the rejected preflight. The exact full Git identity produced a passing check and the subsequent independent veto completed on the unchanged clean commit.
correction.prevention_control: The closeout protocol now requires a standalone git rev-parse HEAD read immediately before every verifier preflight and forbids manually completing abbreviated hashes.

incidents.expected_invariant: Protected-evidence containment requires exact-path reads only; repository-wide or directory-wide content search is forbidden during environment discovery.
incidents.observed_error: While orienting the disposable PostgreSQL plan, Sol issued one rg command over broad scripts, tests, docs and orchestration roots. It returned only ordinary repository paths and no protected content, but repeated AER-0054's prohibited search scope.
incidents.detection_method: Sol recognized the command-scope recurrence from the issued directory roots, preserved a sanitized failure receipt and excluded every broad-search result from architectural authority.

correction.action: The search supplies no architecture authority. Planning continues only from the active named sources, exact known paths and exact executable probes; no recursive repository or documentation search is permitted.
correction.prevention_control: Every environment-discovery step must carry an exact path or executable-name allowlist before execution. Unknown facts become explicit fail-closed plan preconditions rather than triggers for broad search.

incidents.expected_invariant: A verifier explicitly challenging PostgreSQL atomic admission and rollback must account for cluster-scoped roles and must bind psql --single-transaction to a supported -c/-f input mode before returning pass.
incidents.observed_error: The exact-HEAD review returned pass while endorsing a failed-copy rehearsal after a successful installation in another database in the same cluster and plain streamed stdin with --single-transaction. It missed that accepted roles from success are cluster-wide and that psql requires -c/-f for --single-transaction.
incidents.detection_method: Sol's acceptance reconciliation compared the review claims with PostgreSQL 16 psql semantics and the cluster scope of pg_authid/roles before any Docker or database action. The candidate review was rejected despite its pass envelope.

correction.action: The pass is preserved but not admitted. Sol recovered the plan so the invalid transaction runs first while roles are absent and every artifact stream uses --file=- with --single-transaction. A genuinely fresh exact-HEAD replacement veto passed the unchanged recovered commit with no P0-P3 finding.
correction.prevention_control: Database-plan veto acceptance must independently reconcile object scope across database versus cluster catalogues and the exact CLI preconditions of every claimed transaction control, even when the verifier reports pass.

incidents.expected_invariant: A replacement-verifier checkout must use the established short rNN destination so every versioned repository path fits on Windows and clean exact-HEAD preflight can complete before dispatch.
incidents.observed_error: Sol initially used the descriptive destination disposable-pg-plan-recovery-review-009395ac. Git reported Filename too long for four versioned evidence paths and could not reset the index; the destination did not remain present or registered.
incidents.detection_method: The git worktree command failed before verifier dispatch. Sol verified the requested destination was absent and unregistered, preserved the failure receipt, then checked out the unchanged exact commit at r41 and passed preflight before a fresh review call.

correction.action: The failed destination remained absent and unregistered. The unchanged full candidate SHA was checked out at the short r41 destination, passed clean exact-HEAD preflight and received the required fresh replacement veto.
correction.prevention_control: All Windows verifier worktrees use the next short rNN path by default; descriptive tranche identity belongs only in branch, packet and receipt metadata.

incidents.expected_invariant: A verifier assigned complete catalogue reconciliation must compare every exact manifest kind population, not merely the aggregate owned-type total, before returning pass.
incidents.observed_error: The replacement review returned pass and reported only the aggregate 32 fabric types/domains while the plan incorrectly stated 4 domains, 17 enums and 11 composites. The accepted render manifest has 4 domains, 19 enums and 9 composites.
incidents.detection_method: Before implementation, Sol grouped the exact render-manifest ordered_nodes by kind and reproduced DOMAIN=4, ENUM=19 and COMPOSITE=9. No Docker or database command had occurred.

correction.action: The pass is preserved but not admitted. Plan, design and tests now bind the exact 4/19/9/32 population. A genuinely fresh exact-HEAD catalogue-delta veto mechanically reproduced every exact type identifier and all 388 ordered-node kind counts, passed 9/9 focused checks and left its worktree clean; Sol independently reproduced the same one-to-one type-owner set.
correction.prevention_control: Exact-catalogue reviews must mechanically group the manifest node inventory by every claimed kind and compare each count and identifier population; aggregate totals cannot substitute for the requested subdivision.

incidents.expected_invariant: An exact-catalogue implementation veto must mechanically challenge same-name definition drift, complete containment readback and the total runtime deadline before reporting pass.
incidents.observed_error: The review returned pass although same-name definition drift, several container/resource facts and the aggregate execution deadline were not enforced.
incidents.detection_method: Sol reconciled the pass against the plan before Docker resolution and preserved three P1/P2 findings.

correction.action: Sol expanded every closed catalogue projection, exact resource readback and total deadline, then required fresh vetoes through the terminal candidate.
correction.prevention_control: Exactness claims require hostile same-population mutations and explicit checks for every named containment and deadline field.

incidents.expected_invariant: A bounded-output review must distinguish live byte-capped draining from an after-the-fact length check.
incidents.observed_error: The review described Popen.communicate collection as capped even though output could accumulate without bound before rejection.
incidents.detection_method: Sol inspected the exact runner after the pass and rejected it before Docker or database contact.

correction.action: The runner now drains both pipes concurrently, terminates at the hard cap and has hostile live-cap coverage.
correction.prevention_control: Review resource bounds from the data-flow mechanism, not the name or final-size assertion.

incidents.expected_invariant: Exact absence and tmpfs containment checks must admit documented Docker Desktop representations without weakening fail-closed ownership.
incidents.observed_error: One attempt rejected Docker Desktop's No such container phrase before creation; the next rejected an empty normalized Mounts projection despite the exact HostConfig.Tmpfs declaration.
incidents.detection_method: Both owned attempts failed before SQL; the second container was manually reverified, removed by exact ID and proved absent.

correction.action: The harness now admits only the two exact documented absence phrases and requires exact HostConfig.Tmpfs while allowing only the two closed normalized projections.
correction.prevention_control: Position-close engine-specific readback variants from exact owned evidence without replacing immutable ownership checks.

incidents.expected_invariant: The accepted inert renderer must emit PostgreSQL-16-admissible dependency order, physical catalog type names, system-column treatment and relation constraint families.
incidents.observed_error: Serial owned attempts exposed composite forward reference, schema-qualified alias types, an explicit xmin column and interleaved forward foreign keys.
incidents.detection_method: Bounded SQLSTATE evidence and exact source coordinates isolated each repository defect; every failed container was removed and proved absent.

correction.action: The parent renderer gained stable composite and relation-family ordering, exact physical aliases and modeled-xmin omission while preserving 412 statements and all logical contracts.
correction.prevention_control: An inert DDL acceptance must be followed by isolated server admission before any migration or behavioral claim.

incidents.expected_invariant: Readiness must prove a stable authenticated PostgreSQL-16 SQL endpoint, not one socket handshake or an ambiguous host timeout.
incidents.observed_error: Successive attempts exposed bootstrap handoff, host timeout ambiguity, a consistently failing authenticated probe and under-tested version-output normalization.
incidents.detection_method: Value-free readiness counters, exit codes and digests distinguished socket availability from authenticated SQL admission.

correction.action: Readiness now requires continuous paired pg_isready and exact authenticated server-major probes, closed failure classification and hostile version-output tests.
correction.prevention_control: Database readiness must bind the exact authenticated query path used by subsequent work and remain stable across bootstrap handoff.

incidents.expected_invariant: The rollback proof must establish that the fixed appended invalid suffix, rather than an earlier artifact defect, caused the expected transaction failure.
incidents.observed_error: The first checker missed SQLSTATE; later both rollback and success shared SQLSTATE 42601, proving the old rollback claim could falsely attribute an earlier artifact syntax error to the suffix.
incidents.detection_method: Bounded psql error-line and statement-relative coordinates placed failure at artifact line 1980 rather than suffix line 4608.

correction.action: Rollback now requires the exact suffix line plus SQLSTATE and exit, while bounded coordinates diagnose earlier artifact failures without retaining raw text.
correction.prevention_control: Negative tests must bind the failure to the injected mutation's exact coordinate, not merely to an expected error class.

incidents.expected_invariant: Logical body symbols must lower to collision-free physical PL/pgSQL identifiers that remain legal inside embedded SQL.
incidents.observed_error: The logical local primary was emitted physically as primary; PL/pgSQL declaration admitted it but embedded SQL rejected primary.key_id at statement-relative line 352.
incidents.detection_method: Bounded numeric coordinates mapped the failure to the exact accepted body symbol without retaining error text or values.

correction.action: The renderer preserves the logical symbol but lowers it everywhere to cf_primary_admission with collision checks; the exact parent artifact was regenerated and freshly vetoed.
correction.prevention_control: Physical-symbol admission must cover both procedural declarations and every embedded SQL grammar position.

incidents.expected_invariant: The verifier must leave its exact-HEAD worktree byte-clean and may not mutate dependencies or lockfiles.
incidents.observed_error: The r54 verifier changed uv.lock requires-python from >=3.14 to >=3.12 in the read-only review worktree.
incidents.detection_method: Postflight detected the exact one-file mutation; the review was rejected and r54 remained isolated.

correction.action: r54 was not reused; a fresh exact-HEAD r55 used fixed primary-venv commands without uv and passed clean postflight.

incidents.expected_invariant: Review narratives must report the exact collected test total and per-file distribution when those figures are claimed.
incidents.observed_error: One review packet overstated a 106-test run as 107, and r64 reported an 83/24 split although Sol collected the same 107 tests under a different distribution.

correction.action: Sol retained exact collection output as authority and the final r69 review reported the independently confirmed 100 plus 9 distribution.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every runtime state must be valid JSON and use an allowlisted continuation_event before its receipt can authorize action.
incidents.observed_error: A postcompaction state briefly had a trailing comma, and the terminal predispatch state first used worker_dispatch instead of pre_worker_dispatch.
incidents.detection_method: JSON parsing and the orchestrator preflight rejected each state before the affected task action.

correction.action: Both states were corrected and a separate passing receipt was inspected before work continued.
correction.prevention_control: Generate and inspect the receipt in a standalone command before every protected continuation action.

incidents.expected_invariant: The constraint-trigger recovery must change only the intended constraint query and must not hide future non-trigger constraint kinds.
incidents.observed_error: The first edit inserted con.contype into the schema query; the next c/f/p/u allowlist would have hidden exclusion or unknown constraint kinds.
incidents.detection_method: Immediate source inspection caught the first before tests and semantic reconciliation caught the second before review or runtime.

correction.action: The accepted query excludes only contype t and hostile tests require every other unexpected kind to remain visible.
correction.prevention_control: Query-filter repairs require both placement inspection and a future-kind fail-closed challenge before dispatch.

incidents.expected_invariant: Verifier HEAD must be copied from literal Git output and dispatch must be a separate command after a visibly passing receipt.
incidents.observed_error: The first r68 preflight used an invented full hash and failed; the corrected receipt and verifier invocation were then improperly joined with a command separator.
incidents.detection_method: Preflight rejected the false identity. The corrected receipt did pass, but Sol later identified that chaining could have bypassed the intended visible stop.

correction.action: r69 used a literal full git rev-parse identity and three separate commands for receipt generation, receipt inspection and verifier launch.
correction.prevention_control: Never chain receipt creation or inspection with a provider/verifier command; literal Git identity is mandatory.

incidents.expected_invariant: Focused verification commands must use repository-confirmed test paths and must not invent a continuity-test filename.
incidents.observed_error: The first closeout test command named a nonexistent rehearsal_continuity.py file and exited before collecting tests.
incidents.detection_method: Pytest and Ruff returned file-not-found; exact-path discovery found the existing plan test and the corrected 109-test run passed.

correction.action: The exact two existing test files were discovered and passed 109 tests; no file was changed by the failed command.
correction.prevention_control: Resolve test filenames from exact repository path inventory before invoking a focused packet.

incidents.expected_invariant: The continuity updater must be invoked through the repository module path and its node contract evidence must be a subset of explicitly typed node evidence before writing an accepted report.
incidents.observed_error: Direct script invocation failed to import scripts; the first two module invocations then failed Compass validation because terminal evidence and an implementation-test type were not completely linked.
incidents.detection_method: Import and Compass validation failures stopped closeout admission. The updater was repaired and rerun idempotently until the report passed.

correction.action: The updater is invoked with python -m, links terminal evidence under typed node findings, includes the implementation test in contract evidence and now passes idempotently at Continuity 232 / Compass 214.
correction.prevention_control: Continuity closeout requires module invocation plus a successful rendered Compass validation before commit or acceptance.

incidents.expected_invariant: The final independent closeout receipt must report the exact collected and passed total for all seven test files named by its review packet.
incidents.observed_error: The r70 receipt returned pass but reported 214 tests, omitting exactly the three tests in tests/test_agents_acceptance_index.py from the required 217-test packet.
incidents.detection_method: Sol rejected the narrative count after exact r70 collection proved 217 = 100 + 9 + 4 + 77 + 14 + 10 + 3, then required a fresh same-HEAD replacement review.

correction.action: The r70 pass was preserved but not admitted. Fresh r71 at the same exact clean HEAD explicitly collected and passed 100/9/4/77/14/10/3 tests, 217/217 total, reported zero P0-P3 findings and left its worktree unchanged.
correction.prevention_control: Final closeout acceptance must bind each required test path to exact per-file collection and pass counts; any missing path or arithmetic mismatch rejects the review even when its terminal decision says pass.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every text parent hash in a cross-worktree planning contract must use one explicit canonical byte rule that survives Git CRLF checkout without weakening content identity.
incidents.observed_error: Candidate 1f21a3c bound raw checkout bytes for the function/trigger body contract and its test hashed raw bytes, so the exact parent check failed in the fresh Windows review worktree.
incidents.detection_method: The r73 Gemini veto returned revision_required after reproducing the focused parent-hash test failure. Sol then computed raw and canonical hashes for all six parents and found the body contract was the sole divergent text parent.

correction.action: The plan now position-closes canonical UTF-8/LF hashing for all six text parents, rejects lone carriage returns, binds the canonical body-contract hash and verifies the complete parent set under that rule.
correction.prevention_control: Any future cross-worktree text binding must declare and test one canonical newline rule across every bound text parent rather than special-casing only the principal SQL artifact.

incidents.expected_invariant: The independent plan receipt must reconcile the exact per-file collection counts frozen in its packet before reporting a test total.
incidents.observed_error: The r73 receipt reported 118 total, 117 admitted and 116 passed although exact independent collection in that clean worktree yielded 27/9/12/7/36/4/7/22 = 124 admitted plus the one named baseline deselection.
incidents.detection_method: Sol compared the receipt narrative with the packet's frozen per-file arithmetic and independently reran exact per-file collection; the valid P2 finding remained admitted but the count narrative was rejected.

correction.action: The valid cross-worktree hash finding was preserved, but the incorrect count narrative receives no acceptance weight. The replacement veto must print and reconcile each of the eight exact per-file counts before a terminal decision.
correction.prevention_control: Fresh replacement review admission requires exact per-file collect-only and pass arithmetic, not an aggregate progress-line estimate.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every pre-planning receipt must copy one exact continuation_event from the active orchestrator requirements before it may claim five-source rehydration or permit planning.
incidents.observed_error: The first post-pause runtime state used the descriptive event user_resumed_planned_sequence_after_explicit_pause instead of the approved pre_sprint_planning enum. Ariadne preflight returned revision_required, emitted no rehydration sources and prohibited dispatch.
incidents.detection_method: The deterministic local receipt builder failed closed before architecture edits, worker dispatch, model/provider use, database runtime, staging, commit or ref movement.

correction.action: The failed state and receipt remain immutable. A distinct runtime state copied pre_sprint_planning from orchestrator_requirements.yaml, repeated all five named sources and received a passed receipt before planning continued.
correction.prevention_control: Before constructing any receipt, copy continuation_event verbatim from orchestration/harness_settings/orchestrator_requirements.yaml; descriptive lifecycle detail belongs in planned_action and source evidence, never in the enum field.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every frozen behavior scenario must be reachable under its exact principal and grants, and its expected SQLSTATE must match the first effective PostgreSQL privilege or trigger boundary in the accepted body.
incidents.observed_error: Pre-runtime implementation reconciliation found two unreachable trigger claims in the accepted planning packet. BTR-T03 assigned a direct Fabric alias update to context_producer even though that role correctly has no Fabric DML, so PostgreSQL would return 42501 before the alias trigger. BTR-T02 expected deferred CF603 after deleting a same-transaction reschedule event, but cf_guard_event_v1 intentionally rejects that deletion immediately as F_IMMUTABLE/CF601.
incidents.detection_method: Sol traced each rendered scenario from role grants through native PostgreSQL privilege ordering and the exact accepted trigger body before Docker or database execution. The contradictions were reproduced directly from the immutable grant and trigger declarations and the candidate remained runtime-closed.

correction.action: BTR-T03 now tests the producer-reachable committed-event immutable guard without adding Fabric privilege. BTR-T02 now expects its actual immediate F_IMMUTABLE/CF601 guard, while BTR-T01 remains the separate deferred F_TEMPORAL_BIJECTION/CF603 proof. The corrected packet remains closed pending deterministic checks and a fresh exact-HEAD veto.
correction.prevention_control: Before freezing any database behavior scenario, mechanically trace the exact principal through relation privileges, RLS, function ownership and trigger ordering to the first effective boundary; expected SQLSTATEs must bind that first reachable boundary rather than a later intended branch.

incidents.expected_invariant: A descendant that reuses the accepted parent catalogue assertion must preserve both the parent's structural checks and the descendant's distinct fixed disposable database identity.
incidents.observed_error: The first admitted runtime failed closed immediately after artifact admission with catalogue/server_or_database and zero scenarios executed. The behavior harness passed the descendant database facts directly to the accepted parent assertion, whose deliberately frozen parent database sentinel is emr4_synthetic_success rather than the descendant's emr4_synthetic_behavior.
incidents.detection_method: The structured failure evidence recorded a stable PostgreSQL 16 readiness result, artifact admission, zero scenarios, catalogue/server_or_database, empty database stderr and verified owned cleanup. Direct inspection then located the parent's exact database-name sentinel at the first failing assertion.

correction.action: The failed evidence is preserved. A bounded adapter now first proves the exact descendant database name and PostgreSQL 16 major version, deep-copies the catalogue facts, substitutes only the accepted parent's private sentinel in that copy, and then invokes the unchanged parent structural assertion. The repair remains runtime-closed pending deterministic checks and a fresh exact-HEAD veto.
correction.prevention_control: Every reused parent assertion with environment-specific sentinels must have a descendant adapter test that proves the descendant binding independently, proves the original facts remain unchanged, and permits normalization only in a private copy passed to the unchanged structural assertion.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every authored-synthetic fixture row must be ordered after all foreign-key parents required by the accepted PostgreSQL catalogue, including rows used only to prove cross-practice application-read isolation.
incidents.observed_error: The second admitted runtime passed catalogue reconciliation but failed closed during fixture bootstrap with zero scenarios. Static foreign-key tracing found that the practice-beta observer generation was inserted without its required generation-registry barrier and its invalidation watermark was inserted without its required durability checkpoint.
incidents.detection_method: Failure evidence 002 established the new first-effective boundary as fixture/bootstrap_failed after successful catalogue reconciliation, with no scenario execution and verified cleanup. Sol then traced the beta-only projection fixture through fk_cf_06_01 and fk_cf_11_01 in the exact admitted SQL catalogue.

correction.action: The failed evidence is preserved. The beta seed is now one explicit dependency chain: generation-registry barrier, observer generation, durability checkpoint, frame generation, invalidation watermark and reassembly obligation. A static test freezes that CTE order and the exact parent references. The repair remains runtime-closed pending deterministic checks and a fresh exact-HEAD veto.
correction.prevention_control: Before any synthetic PostgreSQL fixture is admitted, mechanically derive a relation dependency DAG from the accepted foreign-key catalogue and require the rendered bootstrap to reference every parent CTE before each child; projection-only isolation rows are not exempt.

incidents.expected_invariant: A verifier must distinguish a plausible static diagnosis from an established first-effective runtime cause and must not claim sole causation without a discriminating SQLSTATE or equivalent bounded observation.
incidents.observed_error: The fixture-repair veto stated that the omitted foreign-key parents solely caused fixture/bootstrap_failed. The next exact-head run still failed at the same generic bootstrap boundary, showing that the foreign-key repair may have been necessary but sole causation was not established by failure evidence 002.
incidents.detection_method: Failure evidence 003 records the same fixture/bootstrap_failed boundary after the accepted dependency-chain repair, with zero scenarios and verified cleanup. This directly falsifies the verifier's sole-cause wording while leaving its static topology observations intact.

correction.action: The topology repair remains as a valid structural correction, but the sole-cause claim is rejected. The next review must label static root-cause analysis as inference until a safe exact SQLSTATE or equivalent bounded runtime discriminator confirms it.
correction.prevention_control: Independent runtime-repair reviews must reserve causal language for evidence with a discriminating observed branch; generic stage/code evidence permits only a plausible-contributor inference and requires diagnostic strengthening before another causal claim.

incidents.expected_invariant: A fail-closed database harness may discard SQL text and messages, but it must retain the single safe five-character PostgreSQL SQLSTATE needed to discriminate repeated first-effective failure boundaries.
incidents.observed_error: Three bootstrap attempts emitted only fixture/bootstrap_failed with an empty-detail digest. The harness captured psql stdout and stderr in memory but discarded the safe SQLSTATE together with prohibited raw diagnostic text, preventing deterministic differentiation of the remaining fixture defect.
incidents.detection_method: Failure evidence 001-003 all preserve cleanup and bounded stage/code facts, while evidence 003 proves that static repair alone did not distinguish the recurring boundary. Source inspection confirmed that the ProcessResult was reduced to a generic BehaviorFailure before evidence construction.

correction.action: The harness now admits only one unambiguous SQLSTATE from a tightly anchored verbose psql ERROR line, releases it in the closed failure object, and continues to discard all SQL and message text. Zero or multiple matches release no SQLSTATE. The diagnostic candidate remains runtime-closed pending tests and a fresh exact-HEAD veto.
correction.prevention_control: Every database failure boundary must explicitly classify which protocol metadata is safe and necessary for diagnosis; retain allowlisted codes such as SQLSTATE while hashing or discarding raw statements, rows and messages.

incidents.expected_invariant: Safe database diagnostics must be sufficient to identify a fixed synthetic fixture defect without releasing raw error text or relying on speculative static repair cycles.
incidents.observed_error: The SQLSTATE diagnostic correctly exposed 23502 but a not-null violation still spans multiple fixed bootstrap relations and columns. SQLSTATE alone classified the error but did not identify the exact allowlisted synthetic schema coordinate needed for a bounded repair.
incidents.detection_method: Failure evidence 004 contains the newly admitted SQLSTATE 23502, zero scenarios and verified cleanup. Static comparison of all bootstrap INSERT columns showed that several relations remain possible without the verbose protocol's schema/table/column fields.

correction.action: The harness now admits schema, relation and column only when verbose psql supplies exactly one of each and the resulting schema-qualified relation plus column belongs to the fixed bootstrap allowlist. Ambiguous or unlisted coordinates release only the SQLSTATE. Raw messages remain discarded.
correction.prevention_control: For fixed synthetic database rehearsals, define an explicit per-relation diagnostic-coordinate allowlist before runtime; release only the minimum protocol coordinate that is both non-data and necessary to resolve a failure class.

incidents.expected_invariant: An independent receipt must name the exact reviewed implementation symbol when making a source-path claim.
incidents.observed_error: The coordinate review reported that all allowlisted relations were written by _bootstrap_sql(), but no such symbol exists; the reviewed renderer is render_bootstrap_sql(). The allowlist conclusion remains independently reproducible, but the symbol-name claim is rejected.
incidents.detection_method: Sol reconciled the receipt narrative with the exact candidate source after admission and found render_bootstrap_sql as the only bootstrap renderer.

correction.action: The nonexistent symbol receives no acceptance weight. The allowlist was rechecked against render_bootstrap_sql and remains valid.
correction.prevention_control: Before accepting a source-symbol claim in a verifier receipt, mechanically resolve the exact symbol in the candidate tree; narrative aliases are not authoritative evidence.

incidents.expected_invariant: When a closed diagnostic coordinate is not released, the evidence must distinguish absent, ambiguous, unlisted-relation and unlisted-column branches without exposing the rejected identifier.
incidents.observed_error: Failure evidence 005 again exposed SQLSTATE 23502 but no coordinate, while the parser returned the same empty-coordinate shape for four materially different fail-closed branches. The result could not distinguish parser-format drift from a correctly rejected allowlist coordinate.
incidents.detection_method: The independently accepted coordinate parser ran once and failure evidence 005 contained neither relation nor column. Source inspection showed every rejection branch returning only the SQLSTATE metadata.

correction.action: The safe failure object now emits exactly one enumerated coordinate_status: missing, ambiguous, unlisted_relation, unlisted_column or released. Rejected identifiers remain absent. The diagnostic remains runtime-closed pending deterministic checks and a fresh exact-HEAD veto.
correction.prevention_control: Every privacy-preserving parser rejection must expose a closed reason code when distinct rejection branches require different safe repairs; the rejected value itself remains sealed.

incidents.expected_invariant: The fixed PostgreSQL client format used by a diagnostic parser must be empirically characterized; an unavailable verbose-field shape must fall back to an equally closed, allowlisted protocol form rather than trigger another speculative repair.
incidents.observed_error: Failure evidence 006 reported coordinate_status=missing with SQLSTATE 23502. The PostgreSQL client emitted the safe SQLSTATE header but did not emit the separately labelled SCHEMA NAME, TABLE NAME and COLUMN NAME lines assumed by the first coordinate parser.
incidents.detection_method: The independently accepted branch-status candidate ran once and deterministically selected its missing branch, proving that neither ambiguous nor unlisted coordinate logic was reached.

correction.action: When labelled fields are absent, the parser now accepts only the exact English PostgreSQL 23502 header shape, captures its lowercase quoted table and column tokens, and releases them only through the existing relation/column allowlist. Every other header remains missing or unlisted with no identifier release.
correction.prevention_control: Before depending on a client diagnostic field layout, preserve a fixed-format characterization test and a minimal allowlisted fallback for the exact observed protocol header; never generalize to free-text parsing.

incidents.expected_invariant: A PostgreSQL domain must not globally forbid NULL when accepted relation invariants and entry-point bodies require a typed null of that domain for a valid zero-position state.
incidents.observed_error: Failure evidence 007 retained SQLSTATE 23502 without table or column coordinates. Static reconciliation found digest_sha256 declared domain-level NOT NULL while ck_cf_07_03 and register_observer_generation_v1 require last_observation_digest to be NULL at position zero.
incidents.detection_method: After the exact table-column header fallback remained missing, Sol reconciled the rendered domain, checkpoint column, ck_cf_07_03 and the registration INSERT, identifying a domain-level not-null violation that exactly explains the diagnostic shape.

correction.action: Renderer 2.0.4 adds one fragment-sealed effective recovery that makes digest_sha256 domain-nullable while preserving its format check, all mandatory column-level NOT NULL constraints and the zero-versus-positive checkpoint invariant.
correction.prevention_control: For every domain with a domain-level NOT NULL constraint, mechanically prove that no accepted column, composite field, CASE expression or entry-point body requires a typed null; otherwise enforce presence at the consuming column instead.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every touched Python file named in an independent review packet must pass the identical Ruff format command locally before dispatch.
incidents.observed_error: The exact-head parse-rebind review passed 169 tests and every substantive binding and containment check but returned revision_required because tests/test_raisa_provider_free_disposable_postgresql_durability_parse_catalogue_rehearsal.py would be reformatted.
incidents.detection_method: Fresh Gemini 3.6 Flash/high exact-head review ran the prescribed Ruff format command and returned exit code 1 with exactly one would-reformat path.

correction.action: The omitted test was mechanically formatted and the exact reviewer Ruff format command now passes locally before a fresh descendant review.
correction.prevention_control: Derive local Ruff check and format targets from every touched Python path in the candidate and run the exact packet commands after the final formatting pass, not a hand-selected subset.

incidents.expected_invariant: When an accepted artifact revision intentionally changes one catalogue fact, every exact derived catalogue digest affected by that fact must be rebound before the revised artifact is executed.
incidents.observed_error: The revised artifact parsed and installed atomically, but exact catalogue admission failed because expected_query_digests.types still encoded digest_sha256.domain_not_null=true. The bounded failure detail digest is exactly sha256(types).
incidents.detection_method: The contained parse run reached artifact_admitted and failed exact_query_digest. Its detail digest matched the digest of query id types, and deterministic authored-synthetic catalogue facts produced the sole revised types digest.

correction.action: The contract now replaces only expected_query_digests.types with the deterministic digest of the revised manifest-derived type facts and binds a new canonical contract digest.
correction.prevention_control: Before executing a contract-bound catalogue revision, derive every exact query digest from the revised authored-synthetic expectation set and compare the full digest map, even when only one source fact is intended to change.

incidents.expected_invariant: A replacement exact catalogue digest must be derived from the complete PostgreSQL query projection and anchored by reproducing the accepted predecessor digest before a changed field is applied.
incidents.observed_error: The first replacement types digest was computed from an incomplete simplified projection that omitted domain definitions, enum labels and composite attributes. The reviewed contained retry therefore failed closed at the same exact types comparison despite successful atomic artifact installation.
incidents.detection_method: The retry reached artifact_admitted, returned the same sha256(types) mismatch marker and cleaned up exactly. A reconstructed 32-row projection reproduces the original accepted types digest byte-for-byte; flipping only digest_sha256.domain_not_null yields a different replacement digest.

correction.action: The replacement digest is now derived from all 32 complete PostgreSQL type projection rows after first proving that the same reconstruction with the predecessor domain flag exactly reproduces the accepted characterization digest.
