incidents.observed_error: The first recovery state used an unapproved pre_integration_recovery event, codex_session_observation for the DeepSeek adapter and omitted the empty deepseek-flash-workers inventory; an imprecise first correction then swapped the Codex and DeepSeek probe methods. Deterministic preflight returned revision_required on both attempts and no integration occurred.
incidents.detection_method: The first preflight named continuation_event_missing_or_unapproved, adapter_probe_method_invalid and worker_slot_inventory_missing; the second named both swapped adapter methods. Direct settings readback supplied pre_integration, codex_session_observation, deepseek_claude_cli_observation and an explicit empty managed slot, after which preflight passed with no reasons.

correction.action: Read the active requirements and transport settings, bind the state to pre_integration and each exact adapter method, include an explicit empty managed DeepSeek slot and require a reason-free receipt before integration.
correction.prevention_control: Every new continuation-state template must be populated from orchestrator_requirements.yaml and transport_adapters.yaml before its first preflight; adapter methods must be keyed by adapter ID rather than patched by positional text match.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every full Git object ID in a receipt state must be captured by exact git rev-parse output before drafting; a displayed short hash may never be expanded or inferred.
incidents.observed_error: While drafting the AES-C1 deterministic-gate precommit state, Sol expanded displayed short HEAD a1a92443 into nonexistent a1a92443855530dfe252a3573a6fa2e05bc0e005 instead of first reading the repository object ID.
incidents.detection_method: Before orchestrator preflight, staging, commit or verifier dispatch, Sol ran git rev-parse HEAD, obtained exact a1a924433d6ea9788dcf54bd52bf4f07e3ba8a46 and corrected the unsubmitted state.

correction.action: Replace the inferred value with exact git rev-parse HEAD output a1a924433d6ea9788dcf54bd52bf4f07e3ba8a46 before preflight, staging, commit or verifier dispatch. No receipt or action used the rejected draft value.
correction.prevention_control: Move exact git rev-parse capture ahead of every packet or runtime-state drafting step and mechanically interpolate only the captured forty-character value; do not begin authoring from abbreviated commit output.

incidents.expected_invariant: Read-only PowerShell evidence probes must use syntactically valid statement boundaries and capture command exit codes in named variables before constructing arrays or objects.
incidents.observed_error: During AES-C2 preplanning, Sol twice piped directly from a foreach statement without first capturing its output and three times embedded a command plus $LASTEXITCODE statement sequence inside a parenthesized object-property expression. PowerShell rejected every affected command at parse time before any probe, worker, source, ref or evidence action ran.
incidents.detection_method: PowerShell returned EmptyPipeElement or MissingEndParenthesisInExpression before execution. Corrected read-only probes first assigned foreach output and command exit state to named variables, then rendered the result; each corrected probe completed successfully.

correction.action: Replace direct foreach piping with an explicit array assignment and replace inline command-plus-exit-code expressions with separate command execution followed by a named Boolean variable before rendering output.
correction.prevention_control: For PowerShell orchestration probes, use one statement per step: capture collection output, run Git or shell commands, capture $LASTEXITCODE, and only then construct the final object. Never place a semicolon-delimited statement sequence inside a property expression.

incidents.expected_invariant: A frozen AES-C2 plan must distinguish the accepted C1 authored-synthetic adapter-artifact identity from the independently computed digest of the new C2 declarative adapter definition.
incidents.observed_error: The first frozen C2 plan required the newly computed implementation-definition digest to equal the C1 manifest adapter_artifact_digest, whose accepted authored-synthetic value is sha256 followed by 64 f characters. That created an infeasible preimage requirement and conflated two different identity layers.
incidents.detection_method: Sol's mandatory pre-dispatch plan challenge read the exact C1 success manifest and compared its pinned adapter_artifact_digest with the C2 plan's proposed computation rule before any DeepSeek worker call.

correction.action: Keep the exact inherited C1 adapter-artifact identity as one equality check and independently recompute the C2 implementation-definition digest against its own registry field, with an explicit prohibition on equality or preimage claims between them.
correction.prevention_control: Every descendant digest rule must name its semantic layer and preimage. Inherited declared identities and newly computed content digests remain separate fields unless an accepted predecessor explicitly defines them as the same content hash.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every incident entry must use one of the register schema's exact closed process_severity values: low, moderate or material.
incidents.observed_error: The first AER-0243 register draft used process_severity value medium. The schema, deterministic report builder and register tests rejected that unrecognised literal before the corrected register or any worker dispatch could be accepted.
incidents.detection_method: The deterministic agent-error register validator returned an exact JSON Schema enum failure at incidents[242].process_severity, and the serial register suite failed only downstream checks that require a schema-valid register.

correction.action: Replace medium with the schema-valid value moderate for AER-0243, add this bounded incident, and rerun schema validation, deterministic report generation and the full register control suite before accepting either entry.
correction.prevention_control: Before adding an incident, read closed enums directly from agent-error-register.schema.json and validate the single draft entry against those exact literals before running the repository-wide derived-report step.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every incident entry must use one of the register schema's exact closed stage values, including deterministic_verification for deterministic schema and report checks.
incidents.observed_error: After the invalid AER-0243 severity value was corrected, the next validator pass exposed validation as a second unrecognised closed-enum literal in AER-0244's stage field. The first enum failure had masked this independent field violation.
incidents.detection_method: The deterministic agent-error register validator returned an exact JSON Schema enum failure at incidents[243].stage before report generation, tests, worker dispatch or candidate work.

correction.action: Replace validation with the schema-valid stage deterministic_verification, link the two masked enum incidents, and validate every enum-valued field in the complete new entries before regenerating the report.
correction.prevention_control: Extract and compare all enum-valued fields in each proposed incident against agent-error-register.schema.json in one prevalidation step; do not correct only the first validator-reported field and assume the remaining literals are admitted.

incidents.expected_invariant: After AER-0242, PowerShell evidence probes must capture each command and object as a separate statement and must quote Git revision-path expressions before consuming their output.
incidents.observed_error: While diagnosing the mis-targeted register patch, one read-only probe again placed a variable expression after a pipeline operator and failed at PowerShell parse time; a second probe left the Git HEAD:path expression unquoted, yielded no JSON to Python and failed before producing evidence. Neither probe changed a file, ref, process or worker state.
incidents.detection_method: PowerShell returned Expressions are only allowed as the first element of a pipeline for the first probe, and Python returned JSONDecodeError on empty stdin for the unquoted Git revision-path probe. A corrected statement-separated PowerShell probe with a quoted Git expression then returned the exact committed value.

correction.action: Use separate PowerShell assignments for Git output, joined JSON text, parsed objects and selected rows; quote HEAD:path as one Git argument; never pipe a variable expression as a mid-pipeline command.
correction.prevention_control: For the rest of AES-C2 orchestration, every PowerShell diagnostic uses literal command statements with named intermediate values and no script-text variable in command position; Git revision-path arguments are always quoted.

incidents.expected_invariant: Register patches must use incident-specific context and related_incident_ids must remain reserved for same-attempt peer incidents.
incidents.observed_error: An underspecified patch intended for AER-0244 matched AER-0003's first empty related_incident_ids block, and the draft also proposed cross-attempt AER-0244/AER-0245 links that the established register contract forbids. Immediate exact-ID inspection found both defects before schema validation, report generation, commit or worker dispatch.
incidents.detection_method: A parsed register probe printed the last incident IDs and selected exact AER-0003, AER-0244 and AER-0245 fields; comparison with quoted git show HEAD evidence established AER-0003's committed empty linkage and the accepted register history confirmed same-attempt-only linkage.

correction.action: Restore AER-0003 to its exact committed empty linkage, keep AER-0244 and AER-0245 unlinked, and patch every remaining register field with the incident_id in the same apply_patch hunk.
correction.prevention_control: Never patch a repeated register key such as status, stage or related_incident_ids without the target incident_id in the same context block; inspect exact target and sentinel incident values immediately after every register patch.

incidents.expected_invariant: A register revision must reconcile all exact derived-pattern fixtures and each new incident assertion with the final validated register wording before the full serial suite is run.
incidents.observed_error: The first schema-valid revision-212 test run passed 214 tests but failed two newly edited expectations: the exact recurring_patterns fixture omitted the admitted AER-0242/AER-0246 recurrence, and the AER-0246 action assertion looked for quoted while the register text used quote.
incidents.detection_method: The complete serial register-control suite reported exactly two assertion failures and 214 passes after schema validation and deterministic report generation had succeeded.

correction.action: Insert the exact generated AER-0242/AER-0246 recurring-pattern object in deterministic order and assert the literal quote HEAD:path wording used by the accepted incident entry, then regenerate and rerun the whole suite.
correction.prevention_control: After every register addition, mechanically compare the freshly generated report's complete recurring_patterns value with the exact test fixture and copy assertion substrings from the final register entry rather than drafting them independently.

incidents.expected_invariant: A preservation-hash probe must use APIs supported by the active Windows PowerShell/.NET runtime and return an exact digest before its result is used as evidence.
incidents.observed_error: The first read-only preservation-hash probe collected the exact 494 baseline paths but attempted Convert.ToHexString, which is unavailable in the active Windows PowerShell/.NET runtime, so the hash field was null and the command reported a method-invocation error. It changed no file, ref, process or worker state.
incidents.detection_method: PowerShell reported that System.Convert has no ToHexString method and rendered a null hash. A corrected probe used System.BitConverter.ToString over the same SHA-256 bytes and returned the accepted f9381b3e31389b512ed04a2eb2c9eec4c5a0a77bf6a673613a746bbc5dd99162 digest for all 494 paths.

correction.action: Format SHA-256 bytes with System.BitConverter.ToString, remove hyphens and lowercase the result; accept the preservation claim only after the exact 494-count and historical digest both match.
correction.prevention_control: Use the already-proven Windows PowerShell-compatible BitConverter hash-rendering snippet for every remaining untracked-set check in AES-C2; do not substitute newer .NET convenience APIs.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every Ariadne adapter observation must use an exact adapter-specific probe method copied from the active transport settings before a post-compaction receipt can authorise candidate review.
incidents.observed_error: The first AES-C2 post-compaction review state described the completed DeepSeek transport with unconfigured method completed_transport_receipt. The orchestrator preflight returned revision_required with adapter_probe_method_invalid:deepseek_via_claude_code_bare, and no candidate correction, integration or external review proceeded on that receipt.
incidents.detection_method: The deterministic preflight emitted the exact invalid-method reason. Direct transport_adapters.yaml readback identified deepseek_claude_cli_observation; a distinct v2 receipt using that exact method then passed with all five rehydration sources and no reasons.

correction.action: Replace the descriptive completed_transport_receipt method with the configured deepseek_claude_cli_observation value, preserve the refused receipt, and bind all further candidate review only to the reason-free v2 receipt.
correction.prevention_control: For every remaining AES-C2 receipt, copy each adapter_id and method as an exact pair from transport_adapters.yaml; completed-transport detail belongs only in the observation evidence string.

incidents.expected_invariant: A worker may self-report AES-C2 pass only when the exact fixed pure adapter is actually called for every reported invocation, no supplied result can bypass that call, the scenario packet rejects undeclared structure, and the closeout distinguishes worker evidence from pending Sol and Gemini acceptance.
incidents.observed_error: DeepSeek candidate 52f1dbb10fd6e616d3190aa896e60d8facf5897d reported pass and three pure-adapter calls, but its adapter-result override returned before calling the pure adapter. Sol measured reported one versus actual zero calls in the malformed-result scenario and showed that a well-formed supplied result could be released as simulated with actual zero adapter calls. The scenario-packet validator also admitted an undeclared top-level field. The closeout consequently overstated total calls and all 15 criteria, misstated the final candidate HEAD and four-ref verification, and said only digest comparison observed a fixture that the plan intentionally supplies to the pure adapter.
incidents.detection_method: Sol read the exact clean seven-path candidate, monkeypatched the only pure adapter to count actual calls, injected a schema-valid result override, and added an undeclared scenario-packet key. The deterministic probes returned MALFORMED_REPORTED 1 ACTUAL 0, VALID_OVERRIDE status simulated and released with ACTUAL 0, and PACKET_EXTRA_KEY_ERRORS as an empty list.

correction.action: The plan's one bounded same-lane revision made the pure adapter call unconditional before observing the exact malformed-result seam, rejected every noncanonical or open scenario packet, added actual-call instrumentation and packet-closure regressions, regenerated evidence, and corrected every HEAD, protected-ref, fixture-observation and pending-acceptance statement. Sol independently reproduced actual call counts, and a fresh exact-head Gemini 3.6 Flash/high veto passed before AES-C2 acceptance.
correction.prevention_control: For simulated adapters, acceptance must instrument the actual fixed callable rather than trust a reported counter, adversarially test every override seam with a schema-valid value, require exact generated scenario-packet equality, and reconcile worker closeout claims against Git and still-pending independent gates.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every agent-error evidence path must resolve to a file in the primary repository root; a file that exists only in an isolated unintegrated worker worktree cannot serve as primary register evidence.
incidents.observed_error: The first AER-0251 draft cited the rejected candidate's closeout, script and test paths as though they existed in the primary worktree. They existed only in the clean isolated worker worktree, so register validation failed on the first missing closeout path before pattern generation; no corrected worker attempt or candidate adoption proceeded.
incidents.detection_method: The full register validator returned evidence path is missing or not a file for orchestration/agent_inbox/claude/raisa-aes-c2-blue-implementation-closeout.md. Exact primary and worker worktree inspection confirmed the provenance distinction.

correction.action: Create a primary Sol rejection record containing the exact candidate SHA and reproduced findings, retain the primary transport receipt, replace every worker-only AER-0251 evidence path with those primary files, and rerun validation plus the complete derived-report suite.
correction.prevention_control: Before every register validation, resolve each newly added evidence path from the primary repository root; represent an unintegrated worker candidate through a primary rejection/receipt artifact rather than its isolated worktree-relative files.

incidents.expected_invariant: A worker predispatch runtime state must use the exact approved pre_worker_dispatch continuation event and must not declare an assigned external worker or invent a workspace receipt before the closed assignment contract exists.
incidents.observed_error: The first AES-C3 worker predispatch state used the unapproved continuation event pre_dispatch, declared deepseek-aes-c3-blue-001 in assigned_agent_ids, and supplied a handwritten workspace entry. The deterministic preflight returned revision_required with continuation_event_missing_or_unapproved and workspace_receipt_missing:deepseek-aes-c3-blue-001. No worker, provider or model call followed that receipt.
incidents.detection_method: scripts/ariadne_orchestrator_preflight.py persisted both exact reasons, set rehydrated_from_receipt false and prohibited dispatch. Sol preserved the failed state/receipt, generated a dedicated clean-worktree preflight, and produced a distinct v2 state using pre_worker_dispatch with empty workspace_receipts and assigned_agent_ids; the v2 receipt passed with all five sources and worker_dispatch_permitted true.

correction.action: No worker dispatch followed the failed receipt. Preserve it, use the exact pre_worker_dispatch event, keep external worker assignment/workspace structures empty, cite the separate dedicated worktree preflight in five-source evidence, and bind launch only to the distinct passing v2 receipt.
correction.prevention_control: For every remaining AES-C3 dispatch receipt, copy continuation_event and assignment fields from a passing external-worker receipt; a separately preflighted worktree belongs in source evidence, while workspace_receipts and assigned_agent_ids remain empty until their harness-governed assignment exists.

incidents.expected_invariant: A new recurrence may reuse an exact recurrence signature without declaring an asymmetric related_incident_ids peer, and every derived count assertion must advance with the validated register population.
incidents.observed_error: The first AER-0253 register draft listed AER-0080 as a one-way related incident even though that historical record could not list the future peer, and it did not yet advance the maintained count assertions. Register validation returned attempt peer linkage mismatch for AER-0253 and the focused suite reported the stale agent-incident count. Pattern generation stopped and no worker dispatch followed.
incidents.detection_method: The deterministic register validator rejected the asymmetric peer linkage before producing a new pattern report, and the focused test identified 162 observed agent incidents versus the stale expected 161. Sol removed the asymmetric peer array, retained the exact recurrence signature as the grouping control, added this incident, advanced all maintained revision/count assertions and regenerated the derived report before dispatch.

correction.action: Keep AER-0253 related_incident_ids empty, retain its exact historical recurrence signature for pattern grouping, add AER-0254 as distinct failed validation evidence, advance register revision/count assertions, regenerate the pattern report and require the full focused register suite to pass before launch.
correction.prevention_control: Before validating a new incident, leave related_incident_ids empty unless the schema's symmetric peer relationship can already exist in both records; update register revision and population assertions in the same patch, then generate the derived report only after standalone validation passes.

incidents.expected_invariant: A register-population correction must update the exact ordered incident range, every maintained aggregate count and the newly recurring pattern fixture before its focused suite can pass.
incidents.observed_error: The second AES-C3 predispatch register correction validated and generated an exact 254-incident pattern report, but the focused suite still found two stale fixtures: the ordered incident range stopped at AER-0252 and the by-origin assertion retained 161 agent-behavior incidents. The exact recurring-pattern fixture also had not yet been extended for the AER-0080/AER-0253 signature. No worker dispatch followed.
incidents.detection_method: The standalone validator and pattern builder passed, then tests/test_ariadne_agent_error_register.py failed the ordered ID list and by-origin count before reaching the stale recurring-pattern assertion. Sol inspected all register-wide exact assertions, added this preserved incident, advanced every affected count/range and inserted the exact generated recurrence block before a fresh validation.

correction.action: Advance the register to 255 incidents, ordered range through AER-0255, 164 agent-behavior and 72 output-contract incidents, 147 canonical-unchanged candidates, and add the exact AER-0080/AER-0253 recurring-pattern fixture before regenerating and rerunning the full focused suite.
correction.prevention_control: After adding any incident, search the complete focused register test for register_revision, incident_count, ordered range, origin/category/candidate-state aggregates and recurring-pattern equality; update them as one atomic mechanical change before running pattern generation.

incidents.expected_invariant: The local command wrapper around a bounded external worker must outlive the worker's own active execution window or yield asynchronously without reporting the active transport as terminally timed out.
incidents.observed_error: The first local shell wrapper for the AES-C3 DeepSeek launch had a 120-second command timeout and returned exit 124 before the underlying launcher/Claude process completed. No transport receipt or source edit existed at that instant, but exact process inspection showed the same launcher and Claude child remained live; Yuri's provider-usage observation was consistent with active work. No duplicate worker was launched.
incidents.detection_method: Immediately after the shell timeout, exact process-tree inspection found the original launcher and claude.exe alive with the authorized packet, worktree and model arguments, while the worktree remained at source d44be5cbe0774b6340c7e4f6ca76075242b2f156. Bounded polling then observed the same process create only seven owned paths, commit candidate 480a0301a1102108fa0779efb98809d55adf0ffa, terminate and write the completed transport receipt.

correction.action: Do not relaunch or terminate the still-live bounded worker. Verify the exact process tree, worktree and absence of a terminal receipt, then monitor the original process until its receipt/commit or the plan's genuine no-artifact terminal window. Admit no source solely from liveness.
correction.prevention_control: Run future long external worker launchers through a sufficiently long or asynchronous wrapper and monitor their own terminal receipt; a shell timeout is harness evidence, not a worker decision, while the exact authorized process remains live.

incidents.expected_invariant: An AES-C3 worker candidate may report pass only when stale lease, alias and token fixtures are exactly bound and actively compared; declared inherited bases control evaluation; malformed attempts return a closed rejection; and every outer status, reason, call count and release count is derived from a checked exact C1/C2 result rather than the scenario label.
incidents.observed_error: DeepSeek candidate 480a0301a1102108fa0779efb98809d55adf0ffa reported the exact 61-scenario totals, but a stale-alias attempt still validated and returned generation_superseded with its replay fixture removed, and changing its declared inherited base to an exact success base also validated without changing behavior. A malformed missing scenario_id raised KeyError. Deterministic contradictory-result probes made the inherited C2 evaluator return allow/simulated with one call and release digests, while the stale-replay and egress branches still emitted their planned outer stop and zero-call claims. The cumulative branches likewise discarded or failed to verify exact returned terminal results before constructing planned outer labels.
incidents.detection_method: After the worker's 93-test packet passed, Sol read the exact seven-path candidate and ran newly authored provider-free probes against validate_attempt and evaluate_attempt. The probes returned no validation errors for a stale alias with replay_artifact null or for a changed inherited base, raised KeyError for a missing required scenario ID, and produced outer stop/zero-call objects that retained contradictory allow/simulated C2 admission and non-null invocation/result digests. Source inspection confirmed replay fixtures had no generation/manifest/Bureau/work-cell/authority binding and were never compared, while the existing tests asserted the hard-coded outer outcomes.

correction.action: The worker self-pass and non-transferable closeout remain rejected. GPT Sol adopted only the seven-path source as untrusted under the recorded recovery lease, added exact replay/current-authority bindings, scenario/base coupling, pre-evaluation validation, result-derived evidence, full cumulative-transition checks and contradictory-result regressions, then obtained one fresh exact-HEAD Gemini 3.6 Flash/high pass over clean recovered commit c45ff191af420b801e9917a7efc69c17aeb5698b.
correction.prevention_control: Containment rehearsals must adversarially replace inherited evaluator results, remove or cross-bind replay fixtures, change declared bases and call the public evaluator with malformed objects. An outer result is admissible only when it checks and derives every claimed status, reason, call and release field from the exact inner result and binding comparison.

incidents.expected_invariant: The AES-C3 focused regression command must use the exact API Spine test path frozen in the worker packet, tests/test_api_spine_artifacts.py, so the complete serial packet actually runs before any pass claim.
incidents.observed_error: The first Sol recovery focused-test command named nonexistent tests/test_api_spine_contract.py. Pytest returned file-or-directory-not-found before collecting any tests, so no result from that command was admitted.
incidents.detection_method: Pytest exited 1 with the exact missing-path error. Sol read the already committed bounded worker packet, recovered its exact tests/test_api_spine_artifacts.py path, and reran the complete C3/C2/C1/C0/API packet serially; all 106 tests passed.

correction.action: Admit no evidence from the missing-path command. Recover the exact API Spine test filename from the frozen worker packet and rerun the complete serial focused packet from the start; the corrected 106-test packet passed.
correction.prevention_control: Copy exact focused test paths from the frozen tranche packet or obtain them from an exact-path repository query before dispatch; a pytest missing-path exit is always zero test evidence and requires a fresh complete packet.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every Ariadne receipt runtime state must use an exact continuation event from the configured vocabulary before its receipt can supply rehydration or continuation evidence.
incidents.observed_error: The first AES-C4 preplanning runtime state used inferred event label pre_plan. The orchestrator preflight returned revision_required because the exact configured preplanning event is pre_sprint_planning. The invalid attempt supplied no admitted receipt evidence and preceded no dispatch, provider call or external mutation.
incidents.detection_method: The orchestrator receipt status and reason rejected the unrecognized continuation event. Sol checked the current configured vocabulary, repeated the complete receipt attempt with pre_sprint_planning and admitted only the resulting passed five-source receipt.

correction.action: Admit no evidence from the invalid event. Preserve the observation and repeat the complete receipt attempt with exact configured event pre_sprint_planning; the corrected five-source receipt passed before AES-C4 planning proceeded.
correction.prevention_control: Copy receipt continuation events from the configured schema or a current passing repository example before running preflight; never abbreviate or infer the machine event from prose.

incidents.expected_invariant: A pre-worker-dispatch runtime state must use an exact configured adapter observation method, include every required worker-slot inventory and declare only workspace receipts supported by the current orchestrator profile before it can authorize a verifier.
incidents.observed_error: The first AES-C4 verifier pre-dispatch state used method antigravity_new_project_bound_readonly_worktree instead of agy_cli_observation, omitted the required deepseek-flash-workers slot by substituting a Gemini slot and declared workspace receipt gemini-aes-c4-provider-proof-review-001 without a matching configured inventory. The receipt returned revision_required with adapter_probe_method_invalid, worker_slot_inventory_missing and workspace_receipt_missing. No worker started.
incidents.detection_method: The orchestrator preflight emitted the three exact rejection reasons before dispatch. Sol read one current passing Gemini pre-dispatch runtime state, preserved the invalid state/receipt and repeated the complete attempt using exact adapter method agy_cli_observation and its accepted inventory shape.

correction.action: Admit no dispatch authority from the invalid receipt. Preserve it, recover the exact current Antigravity pre-dispatch observation and inventory shape from a passing repository state, then repeat the full receipt before launching the verifier.
correction.prevention_control: Build dispatch runtime states from the current configured adapter methods and slot inventory or an exact current passing example; do not infer adapter method names or declare reviewer slots/workspace receipts absent from the profile.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every source-bound AES-C4 evidence packet and terminal ledger must receive the exact forty-character current commit object captured from git rev-parse and verified as an existing commit before evidence generation.
incidents.observed_error: The first factual-rebind zero-call evidence and ledger used non-existent source string ec6a04345fb8a5ec65da112fbacbc98bfb040030 copied from restored summary state instead of actual committed HEAD ec6a043410661d563c53d205cd4958d100732e97. Complete post-compaction Git verification found the mismatch before review, cloud preflight, ledger opening or provider inference. The invalid pair made zero provider calls and supplied no admitted evidence.
incidents.detection_method: The mandatory five-source rehydration captured git rev-parse HEAD, git cat-file resolution and the evidence source_head independently. Sol preserved the invalid pair under explicit invalid-source filenames, verified the actual commit object and regenerated the complete zero-call pair from the exact current HEAD.

correction.action: Admit neither invalid-source file. Preserve both, verify the exact current commit with git rev-parse and git cat-file, regenerate a distinct complete zero-call evidence/ledger pair bound to ec6a043410661d563c53d205cd4958d100732e97 and require that corrected pair to pass deterministic tests before any verifier or cloud gate.
correction.prevention_control: Before any source-bound evidence generation, capture full HEAD from git rev-parse, verify it with git cat-file, and pass that same captured value directly to the harness; never copy a restored summary or abbreviated display hash into source_head.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every Ariadne pre-planning receipt runtime state must use exact configured continuation event pre_sprint_planning before it can supply five-source rehydration or planning authority.
incidents.observed_error: The first AES-C5 pre-planning runtime state repeated the inferred event label pre_plan already recorded in AER-0259. The orchestrator receipt returned revision_required with continuation_event_missing_or_unapproved and supplied no admitted rehydration or planning evidence. No product read, provider call or external mutation occurred.
incidents.detection_method: The deterministic orchestrator preflight rejected the unapproved event before planning. Sol preserved the invalid state and receipt, read the exact configured vocabulary and repeated the full five-source attempt using pre_sprint_planning; the corrected receipt passed.

correction.action: Admit no evidence from the invalid event. Preserve the rejected state and receipt, read the current configured vocabulary and repeat the complete five-source receipt with exact event pre_sprint_planning before any AES-C5 inspection or planning proceeds.
correction.prevention_control: Copy every continuation event directly from orchestration/harness_settings/orchestrator_requirements.yaml or a current passed receipt; never abbreviate or infer the machine event label from prose.

incidents.expected_invariant: AES-C5 repository inspection must use exact named non-protected source files and must never list, search, enumerate or open a protected holdout fixture, support module, manifest, seal, receipt or per-case report.
incidents.observed_error: The first AES-C5 source inspection used one broad recursive text query over application, API-documentation, test and orchestration roots. Its scope traversed protected holdout fixture paths and returned matches. No output from that search is admitted or used, and no protected filename, label, case, value or content is retained in register evidence.
incidents.detection_method: The command output visibly crossed into a protected holdout fixture namespace. Sol stopped using the result, recorded a sanitized scope-breach analysis without protected content and replaced broad discovery with an explicit named-file allowlist.

correction.action: Abandon the entire broad-search output and admit none of it as AES-C5 evidence. Record the prohibited traversal, keep the worktree unchanged and restart inspection using only explicit named non-protected route, schema, service, authorization, API Spine and focused test files.
correction.prevention_control: Never use a repository-root or broad tests/orchestration search for product-source discovery. Construct an exact source allowlist from already accepted route artifacts and direct imports, and explicitly exclude every fixture, support, holdout, manifest, seal, receipt and report path before inspection.

incidents.expected_invariant: A frozen AES-C5 plan that records the legacy route-readiness approval as expired must preserve that fail-closed status and must not require the expired general readiness check to pass as authority for the newer exact one-run rehearsal.
incidents.observed_error: The first frozen plan correctly named the 2026-08-08 expiry but still listed static route-readiness release checks among passing deterministic gates. The exact script failed with route readiness approval has expired. No product source, PostgreSQL rehearsal, credential, cloud control or provider operation occurred.
incidents.detection_method: The exact legacy release-check script stopped before implementation dispatch. correction.action: Replace only the invalid value with configured expected_leverage positive, retain after-contract-freeze timing in rationale, regenerate the receipt and require passed before plan freeze.
correction.prevention_control: Construct every parallelism assessment from the configured enum vocabulary and the last passing exact analogue; express timing, qualifications and net leverage only in rationale text.

incidents.expected_invariant: A not-yet-dispatched worker lane must use an admitted Ariadne parallelism disposition in the plan-precommit runtime state.

incidents.detection_method: The local Ariadne preflight emitted parallelism_lane_disposition_invalid:deepseek_flash; the regenerated state used planned and passed before the plan commit.

correction.action: Replace selected with the admitted planned disposition, retain the exact future work package and regenerate a passing plan-precommit receipt before commit.
correction.prevention_control: Reuse the last passing stage-equivalent parallelism object and validate its disposition vocabulary locally before any plan, dispatch or verifier boundary.

incidents.expected_invariant: An external worker worktree intentionally based on the frozen task-plan source must carry the exact resource-bound receipt, explicit permitted divergence and no internal assigned-agent id.

incidents.detection_method: Two local Ariadne preflight attempts returned the exact workspace reasons; the passing descendant recorded at_handoff_current false, the plan-source divergence and recorded_at timestamp while leaving assigned_agent_ids empty.

correction.action: Record at_handoff_current false, the exact frozen-plan divergence and recorded_at timestamp in the resource-bound worktree receipt, leave assigned_agent_ids empty for the external adapter, and require a passing pre-dispatch receipt.
correction.prevention_control: External worker receipts must use the last passing resource-bound schema, explicitly record every permitted non-handoff source relation and keep internal assignment inventory separate from external adapter dispatch.

incidents.expected_invariant: A worker may self-report pass only when the canonical authored-synthetic evidence is internally valid and the closed contract exactly represents the frozen authority, signed-evidence, optional-reason and atomic artifact requirements.
incidents.observed_error: DeepSeek returned pass with 19 focused tests, but its canonical confirmation occurred after its own evidence expiry, its top-level contract omitted exact current-role/capability and signed-evidence field sets, and it represented no successful null optional cancellation-text path.
incidents.detection_method: Sol reran the focused tests, read all six owned files and used direct packet probes to compare confirmed_at with expires_at, inspect closed contract keys and search for a successful null-text decision and atomic schedule. The tests passed while all four semantic probes failed.

correction.action: Preserve the worker commit as rejected untrusted provenance, close the same-lane correction loop, adopt only its six-file source under the named Sol recovery lease, repair the expiry relation and exact authority/evidence/atomic/null-text contracts, add direct regressions and require a fresh exact-candidate Gemini veto after deterministic admission.
correction.prevention_control: Before any worker self-pass is admitted, independently validate canonical temporal relations and enumerate every frozen closed-contract field and nullable success coordinate; focused test success cannot substitute for semantic packet admission.

incidents.expected_invariant: Protected holdout, fixture, support and authoring surfaces must never be opened, enumerated or searched; physical-representability discovery must begin from exact already-known non-protected paths rather than any directory root.
incidents.observed_error: During delete-confirm physical-representability discovery, Sol queried Git filename metadata under several scoped application, migration and API directory roots. No file content was opened, but two protected authoring path names appeared among otherwise non-protected candidates. Sol stopped immediately, discarded the output and prohibited its use in planning, implementation, tests or acceptance.
incidents.detection_method: The metadata output visibly crossed into protected authoring path names. Sol stopped source discovery, preserved a sanitized incident receipt and registered the breach before freezing the representability plan or opening application content.

correction.action: Discard and prohibit use of the enumerated protected path names, preserve a sanitized incident receipt, register AER-0325 before review planning, and restart only from exact already-known non-protected paths copied from accepted documents.
correction.prevention_control: For physical-representability discovery, every filename-metadata and content command must name exact already-known non-protected files. Directory roots are prohibited even when narrowly scoped or filtered. Any expansion must follow an exact link inside an already allowlisted file and requires plan revision before opening.

incidents.expected_invariant: A bounded occupied DeepSeek inventory lease must produce its one owned JSON artifact and structured terminal receipt within the observation window, or stop with exact worktree containment before fallback.
incidents.observed_error: The exact worker call exceeded the 124-second outer observation bound without a terminal result file. Exact readback found the worker still at the frozen source HEAD with no owned inventory path and no tracked change.
incidents.detection_method: The launcher command returned timeout exit 124. Sol then checked only the exact result path, worker HEAD and owned inventory path and found no candidate or terminal closeout.

correction.action: Reject the worker attempt, admit no source, preserve the exact unchanged worktree evidence and transfer the mechanical inventory and synthesis to Sol without a same-lane retry.
correction.prevention_control: A recurrent DeepSeek no-terminal transport event triggers direct Sol fallback after exact result-path, owned-path, HEAD and worktree readback; no same-lane retry or late source adoption is permitted without a distinct authorised recovery.

incidents.expected_invariant: The exact clean Gemini verifier candidate must be on a named non-protected codex/review branch and pass the verifier-worktree preflight before pre-verifier receipt or Antigravity dispatch.
incidents.observed_error: Sol created the exact candidate worktree at detached HEAD and issued a pre-verifier receipt without first running the mandatory verifier-worktree preflight. The Antigravity wrapper rejected the empty branch before project creation or any provider/model call.
incidents.detection_method: The local wrapper returned Antigravity refuses protected or detached branch and produced no review receipt; corrected exact-HEAD preflight then passed with provider_or_model_calls zero.

correction.action: Attach the unchanged worktree to codex/review-delete-confirm-representability-bc066a1b, pass exact-HEAD clean verifier preflight with provider_or_model_calls zero, revise the workspace receipt and generate a distinct fresh pre-verifier receipt before retry.
correction.prevention_control: Never create an Antigravity verifier worktree with --detach. Create it directly on a named codex/review branch and require scripts.ariadne_verifier_worktree_preflight to pass before constructing the pre-verifier runtime state.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every exact verifier command manifest must pass the local evidence gate, including its uppercase command-id vocabulary, before a pre-verifier receipt or Antigravity dispatch.
incidents.observed_error: Sol supplied five unique lowercase command ids. The Antigravity wrapper rejected command[0] as invalid or duplicated before project creation or any provider/model call; no review receipt was created and the exact candidate remained unchanged.

correction.action: Replace only the five manifest ids with uppercase admitted tokens, pass scripts.ariadne_evidence_gate over the exact manifest, preserve zero-call postflight evidence and generate a second distinct corrected pre-verifier receipt before retry.
correction.prevention_control: Run scripts.ariadne_evidence_gate --command-manifest against every new verifier manifest before constructing the pre-verifier receipt; command ids must match ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_-]{0,31}$ exactly.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every forty-character Git source binding must be copied from literal git rev-parse output and verified as a commit before it enters any runtime state, receipt or review packet; an abbreviated commit display must never be expanded by inference.
incidents.observed_error: While drafting an uncommitted post-model-change runtime state, Sol expanded displayed short HEAD f6502046 into nonexistent f6502046c5dcc5b446e63fb9035d91f66d9d993c instead of first capturing the exact object identity.
incidents.detection_method: Before receipt admission or verifier dispatch, Sol recognized the inferred value, ran git rev-parse HEAD, obtained exact f650204638287776ba32aea44655ca7e1b01809d and replaced both draft occurrences.

correction.action: Admit no draft under the inferred value. Capture literal git rev-parse HEAD output f650204638287776ba32aea44655ca7e1b01809d and replace every draft occurrence before receipt admission or dispatch.
correction.prevention_control: Capture and retain the forty-character HEAD in a named scalar immediately after every commit and before drafting any source-bound packet, runtime state or receipt; never construct or autocomplete an object ID from abbreviated terminal output.

incidents.expected_invariant: A preplanning parallelism assessment must use the exact live active-operation id and only the configured expected_leverage vocabulary before any native or external worker dispatch.

correction.action: Align the parallelism assessment to the exact live operation id, replace the invented leverage values with configured positive for the DeepSeek and native lanes and required_independence for Gemini, then generate and read back a fresh passing receipt before dispatch.
correction.prevention_control: Copy operation_id directly from the validated live latch and select every expected_leverage value from the configured enum before receipt generation; express timing or qualifications only in rationale text and require exact passed readback before dispatch.

incidents.expected_invariant: A worker may self-report pass only when its exact clean owned-path candidate satisfies the frozen universal command-identity conflict, append-only journal ordering, contradictory-gate evidence, exact refinement-promotion binding and history-derived rollback invariants; Sol semantic admission and a later fresh independent veto remain mandatory.
incidents.observed_error: DeepSeek returned DECISION pass for clean nine-path candidate 7ff8ea25b03b691bad0feef179e9cb05f01c72f4 with 173 focused tests and 139 hostile mutations, but exact Sol/native read-only review found that request conflicts were not universal, reordered or retired unfinished journal history remained admissible, contradictory exact gate results used latest-wins, refinement promotion omitted exact source/Sol/global-reviewer admission and misreported rejection, and rollback trusted fabricated caller coordinates and history.
incidents.detection_method: Sol and a bounded native read-only audit reviewed the exact clean child of plan source 961a833b65e57682e10088300f4b7909a5a5aee8 after independently confirming the 173-test pass. Their direct semantic probes returned revision_required for five fail-closed contract gaps before integration or Gemini dispatch.

correction.action: Preserve candidate 7ff8ea25b03b691bad0feef179e9cb05f01c72f4 and its worker pass only as untrusted provenance, admit no acceptance claim, close same-lane correction, and transfer one bounded five-part correction to Sol before deterministic re-admission and one fresh Gemini 3.7 Flash/high veto.
correction.prevention_control: Before admitting any worker self-pass for a stateful harness contract, independently probe every command state for identity conflict, preserve literal append order, reject contradictory same-fingerprint gate history, require exact proposal/source/reviewer/promoter binding, and derive rollback solely from validated immutable promotion history; test counts and hostile-mutation totals never substitute for semantic admission.

incidents.expected_invariant: An outer orchestration timeout around Antigravity must cover the launcher's declared inner adapter timeout or yield asynchronously; an outer timeout cannot be treated as terminal while the exact authorized Python and agy process remains active.
incidents.observed_error: Sol set the first Gemini 3.7 veto launch's outer shell timeout to 120 seconds while the Antigravity launcher carried a 30-minute print timeout. The shell returned exit 124 after 124 seconds even though the exact existing Python and agy process remained active.
incidents.detection_method: After exit 124, Sol inspected the exact process tree, receipt path and verifier worktree, observed the original process still live and did not retry. That same process completed one valid pass receipt for candidate 79f5d6cf1cbe4ca9ad4893f257e92eccfd2ac2ce, then exact postflight confirmed unchanged HEAD and a clean worktree.

correction.action: Treat the outer exit 124 as non-terminal process-orchestration evidence, inspect the exact process, receipt and worktree, forbid duplicate dispatch, and admit only the original process's later valid receipt plus clean postflight.
correction.prevention_control: Set every outer orchestration timeout to cover the declared inner adapter timeout. After any outer timeout, inspect the exact process, receipt and worktree before considering recovery; never retry while the original authorized process may still complete.

incidents.expected_invariant: After a wrapper-timeout incident, every long local verification gate must declare an internal timeout and an outer timeout larger than that budget plus margin; later gates must not be chained behind the long-running test.
incidents.observed_error: Immediately after AER-0332, Sol reused the same fixed 120-second outer shell timeout for a broader six-file local closeout pytest, Ruff and diff chain. The wrapper returned exit 124 after about 123.7 seconds and pytest emitted a stdout-flush OSError before the chained Ruff or diff gates could produce admissible results.
incidents.detection_method: Exact process inspection after exit 124 found no surviving Python child. Sol therefore rejected the interrupted pytest result and claimed no Ruff or diff outcome from that command, then separated the gates for bounded rerun with ariadne_serial_pytest and an outer timeout demonstrably larger than its internal budget.

correction.action: Admit no result from the interrupted chain. Rerun each gate independently; run pytest only through ariadne_serial_pytest with an explicit internal timeout and an outer timeout larger than the internal budget plus margin, then record each exact result separately.
correction.prevention_control: Never reuse an arbitrary fixed wrapper timeout after a timeout incident. Derive outer timeout greater than inner timeout plus margin, and never chain Ruff, diff or other later gates behind a long pytest process.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every admission gate must expose its own exit status, package-aware repository CLIs must use their admitted module invocation, and a later successful command must never mask an earlier validation failure.
incidents.observed_error: Sol chained active-latch validation, journal validation and git diff in one shell command. The first two file-path CLI invocations failed to import orchestration_harness, while the final successful diff made the shell call return zero. An independently captured pytest also rejected the draft latch's non-admitted in-progress terminal reason.
incidents.detection_method: The separate pytest process returned one explicit failure for terminal_response.reason. Sol then read the validator's exact invariant, corrected the literal, reran both CLIs through python -m and captured latch, journal, focused pytest and diff as four independent passing process results before plan commit or worker dispatch.

correction.action: Correct terminal_response.reason to unfinished_authorized_operation, invoke package-aware CLIs with python -m, and rerun latch, journal, focused pytest and diff as four separately captured gates before admitting the plan.
correction.prevention_control: Admission gates may be parallelized only as separately captured process results. Never chain validations where a later success can mask an earlier exit, and invoke repository package CLIs through their admitted python -m module path.

incidents.expected_invariant: A worker predispatch state must use the admitted parallelism disposition and a field-complete workspace receipt, including the exact at_handoff_current boolean, before dispatch can be permitted.
incidents.observed_error: The first DeepSeek predispatch receipt draft used non-admitted disposition active and omitted at_handoff_current from the workspace receipt. Deterministic preflight rejected the draft before any worker dispatch.
incidents.detection_method: The local orchestrator preflight returned revision_required for the invalid lane disposition and incomplete workspace receipt. Sol corrected the state to disposition dispatched with at_handoff_current true; the distinct regenerated receipt passed before the worker launched.

correction.action: Preserve the rejected draft, replace active with admitted dispatched, add at_handoff_current true to the exact workspace receipt, and require a distinct passing predispatch receipt before worker launch.
correction.prevention_control: Construct worker predispatch lane and workspace objects from the last passing stage-equivalent receipt, selecting disposition from the configured enum and emitting every required workspace field before preflight.

incidents.expected_invariant: A worker receipt may declare DECISION pass only when every mandatory packet command exits zero; a known or pre-existing required-gate failure must yield revision_required rather than a pass qualified by prose.
incidents.observed_error: DeepSeek self-declared pass for candidate bc0b8adcdc9f1c11bb69abe1514677a92d17f9c7 even though mandatory legacy status-scaffold command 3 exited 1 with one failed OpenAPI-hash assertion. The receipt described the failure accurately but its terminal pass contradicted the required command result.

Command 3 reported 10 passed and 1 failed, so candidate bc0b8adcdc9f1c11bb69abe1514677a92d17f9c7 remained revision_required and no integration or acceptance followed.

correction.action: Reject the worker's terminal pass, preserve its clean nine-path candidate only as untrusted revision-required provenance, admit no source, and transfer the mandatory-gate diagnosis and any bounded correction to Sol.
correction.prevention_control: Worker result admission must compare the terminal decision mechanically with every mandatory command exit; any nonzero required gate overrides pass prose and yields revision_required before source adoption.

incidents.expected_invariant: After AER-0334 and its explicit no-chaining control, every validation and readback gate must run as a separately captured process so a later command cannot mask an earlier nonzero status.
incidents.observed_error: Sol recurrently chained validation and readback commands with semicolons after AER-0334 and the explicit no-chaining reminder. Even where output appeared expected, the command form allowed a later process status to mask an earlier failure in principle.
incidents.detection_method: Sol recognized the recurrent command shape before admitting the chained outcomes, rejected those aggregate shell statuses and reran every affected validation and readback gate as a separate process with its own exact exit result.

correction.action: Admit no chained aggregate status and rerun every affected validation and readback gate separately, capturing each exit before using its evidence.
correction.prevention_control: After a no-chaining incident, semicolon-composed validation or readback commands are prohibited. Use one process call per gate and record its exit before starting the next gate.

incidents.expected_invariant: A mandatory legacy status-scaffold regression must run at plan preflight and its frozen OpenAPI digest must match the unchanged current API Spine source before a descendant candidate can use the suite as acceptance evidence.

The worker later exposed its pre-existing stale expected digest c3885ccee077df8f316b8ee8167d56a00673473841cbd57401df980d2a61c4b6 while the unchanged current appointment-commands OpenAPI digest was c5493c14efd92b3d3fc3d8a0ef33d3e3a266fa1d0961ad90ebbc37e4b4065a3a.
incidents.detection_method: Sol reproduced the identical one-test failure at plan source d500f1f86a83695cee0c2aac93aa2e2735e8f799 and candidate bc0b8adcdc9f1c11bb69abe1514677a92d17f9c7. Git confirmed the legacy test and OpenAPI were unchanged between them; the test SHA-256 remained 28060c2f5b1cb4ff00f62b498511995a35a630963e586920115f34740c5d1ac3.

correction.action: Freeze one test-only digest correction from c3885ccee077df8f316b8ee8167d56a00673473841cbd57401df980d2a61c4b6 to unchanged current c5493c14efd92b3d3fc3d8a0ef33d3e3a266fa1d0961ad90ebbc37e4b4065a3a, with no product or OpenAPI edit, then rerun the mandatory legacy gate separately before candidate admission.
correction.prevention_control: Run every mandatory legacy regression at the plan source before worker dispatch, bind frozen digests to the exact current source, and classify any source-identical expectation drift before evaluating descendant causation.

incidents.expected_invariant: The canonical fast profile must run at the exact plan source before worker dispatch so pre-existing baton drift is separated from candidate-caused dependency changes and the descendant packet binds every expected additive assertion update.
incidents.observed_error: Sol did not run the canonical fast profile at plan source d500f1f86a83695cee0c2aac93aa2e2735e8f799 before dispatch. The later exact candidate profile exposed four failures: one candidate-caused dependency assertion that did not yet allow additive authority_generation, and three stale current-baton assertions already failing at the exact plan source after the accepted Ariadne harness closeout.
incidents.detection_method: Sol ran the complete profile on candidate bc0b8adcdc9f1c11bb69abe1514677a92d17f9c7, isolated all four failures, then reproduced the three current-baton failures at exact plan source d500f1f86a83695cee0c2aac93aa2e2735e8f799 while the authority_generation dependency assertion remained candidate-specific.

correction.action: Plan-bind the one candidate dependency assertion and three source-stale current-baton assertions separately, apply only their narrowly scoped expectation corrections, rerun each affected test independently, then rerun the complete canonical fast profile before candidate admission.
correction.prevention_control: Every worker plan must run and record the complete canonical fast profile at its exact source before dispatch; descendant failures are classified against that baseline before any candidate repair or acceptance claim.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every agent-error register batch edit must update all exact population fixtures, including the standalone agent-origin length, before the first full focused acceptance run.

No register result was accepted; adding this incident makes the final exact agent-behavior population 235 before corrected rerun.

correction.action: Update the standalone agent-origin population to final exact 235, reconcile revision 301, incident count 340, aggregate and recurrence fixtures, regenerate the pattern report and rerun the complete focused file.
correction.prevention_control: Before the first full run after any register edit, mechanically search the entire focused test for revision, ID range, standalone origin lengths, totals, aggregate dictionaries and recurrence equality, then compare every literal with a freshly built report.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every verifier manifest command must resolve candidate-only paths inside the exact review worktree; a shared serial wrapper anchored to another checkout may not receive relative candidate paths.

The wrapper correctly serialized pytest but set cwd to its own primary repository, where the unintegrated delete-confirm focused test did not exist, so one of six commands exited 1 and the verifier returned revision_required.
incidents.detection_method: The exact clean bdfea42a candidate received one terminal Gemini revision_required decision. Its receipt records five zero exits, one FOCUSED_TESTS file-not-found exit, an unchanged clean worktree and a substantive architecture audit reporting no product defect.

correction.action: Keep candidate bdfea42a unchanged, preserve the failed receipt, and issue a fresh manifest whose serial wrapper receives exact absolute test paths inside the review worktree before one fresh Gemini 3.7 Flash/high veto.
correction.prevention_control: When a verifier invokes a helper from outside the candidate worktree, every candidate-owned path passed through that helper must be absolute and preflighted for existence under the exact review root; command admission must reject cross-checkout relative paths.

incidents.expected_invariant: A fresh five-source receipt must bind the admitted live-latch fingerprint and use the configured parallel-lane disposition vocabulary before planning or dispatch.

correction.action: Align the latch to the exact configured fingerprint and terminal reason, move lane timing into rationale and work-package fields, then require a distinct corrected receipt before planning.
correction.prevention_control: Generate receipt vocabulary from the admitted settings and live-latch schemas; never invent terminal or lane disposition literals in a continuation state.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every full Git object ID used for worktree creation or evidence binding must be copied from a successful exact Git readback.
incidents.observed_error: The first worker-worktree command expanded the displayed short commit into a manually invented full object ID. Git rejected the nonexistent reference before creating the worktree.

correction.action: Read the complete plan source literally with git rev-parse, bind that value into the latch and packet, and create the worker worktree only from that exact object.
correction.prevention_control: A full Git object ID may enter a command, receipt or plan only through literal Git output or an already validated durable field; manual short-SHA expansion is prohibited.

incidents.expected_invariant: An asynchronous focused test run must retain its process identity until an exact terminal exit status is captured before the result is admitted.
incidents.observed_error: The first wrapper emitted child output but discarded the running process identifier, leaving the eventual exit status unattributable even though visible pytest output completed.

correction.prevention_control: Every yielded process must preserve and poll its returned session or cell identity through terminal completion; visible output without an attributable exit is not gate evidence.

incidents.expected_invariant: The risk-weighted admission implementation must derive and compare every authority-bearing freeze, reuse, veto, parallelism and renderer boundary instead of trusting candidate-declared values.
incidents.observed_error: The first worker candidate could admit stale freeze details, accept a self-asserted reuse fingerprint, count a mechanical lane as an independent veto, omit planned-versus-actual parallelism comparison, return pass after a declared-decision mismatch, overwrite protected renderer paths and narrow malformed verifier input.
incidents.detection_method: Sol's source review and hostile regression design rejected worker source 85a0877face2f16af80a07217918bf86b370febd despite its 118 passing focused tests; no verifier or integration admitted that candidate.

correction.action: Sol recovered the exact worker candidate by deriving all authority-bearing bindings, restricting veto lanes, comparing actual parallelism, failing closed on every reason, protecting renderer targets and adding hostile regressions before freezing 51866ce084c33fce600b792c66b180927658ed9e.
correction.prevention_control: Mechanical workers may construct authority tooling, but Sol must independently trace every field that can release pass, reuse evidence, satisfy a veto or select a write target before semantic freeze.

incidents.expected_invariant: Candidate-only verifier arguments must be parsed by the exact candidate checkout's preflight implementation before reviewer dispatch.
incidents.observed_error: The first review-preflight command invoked the primary checkout's older script, whose parser did not yet know the candidate manifest, path and serial-root arguments, so argparse rejected them before producing a receipt.
incidents.detection_method: The command exited at argument parsing with no reviewer dispatch; path readback showed that the requested verifier capability existed only in the exact candidate checkout.

correction.action: Invoke the exact candidate checkout's preflight script with the shared interpreter and bind the exact review root, candidate HEAD, validated manifest and candidate-relative paths.
correction.prevention_control: For a tranche that changes verifier tooling, review preflight and command manifests must resolve the tool from the exact candidate root unless a separately versioned external tool is explicitly frozen.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every verifier manifest command must run the exact candidate-compatible helper rooted in the clean review checkout.
incidents.observed_error: The first Gemini manifest invoked the primary checkout's old serial runner for C03. It rejected the candidate-only --repo-root option, producing revision_required even though Gemini's source audit found every required invariant satisfied.
incidents.detection_method: The preserved Gemini 3.7 Flash/high receipt recorded six passing commands, one C03 parser failure, clean source state and no substantive source defect at exact candidate 51866ce084c33fce600b792c66b180927658ed9e.

correction.action: Preserve the failed receipt, bind a distinct corrected manifest to the candidate checkout's serial runner, revalidate manifest and root preflight, then use the one authorised corrected final veto on the unchanged candidate.
correction.prevention_control: Manifest admission must verify executable-helper provenance against the exact review root and reject primary-checkout fallthrough whenever candidate tooling changed.

incidents.expected_invariant: The active latch and every continuation receipt must describe the same owned internal-only Docker network and fixed loopback relay frozen by the Tier-2 behavior plan.
incidents.observed_error: The committed preplanning latch snapshot retained the preceding parse/catalogue tranche's network-none wording even though the behavior plan correctly requires one owned Docker internal network and no published port.
incidents.detection_method: Pre-dispatch comparison of the active latch, preplanning receipt and frozen behavior plan found the exact network-mode contradiction before any worker or database execution.

correction.action: Replace only the stale network-none wording with the frozen owned internal-only network, no-published-port and loopback-relay boundary, then regenerate the preplanning and pre-dispatch receipts before launch.
correction.prevention_control: Pre-dispatch must compare lifecycle-mode tokens in the active latch and source evidence with the frozen plan rather than relying only on receipt schema validation.

incidents.expected_invariant: A frozen text-source binding must identify the same committed content in the primary and every clean exact-HEAD worker or reviewer worktree.
incidents.observed_error: The plan bound a generated JSON evidence file's primary-worktree CRLF byte hash. The clean worker checkout materialized the gitattributes-required LF bytes, so equal committed content produced a different raw SHA-256 and the worker candidate failed closed.
incidents.detection_method: DeepSeek returned revision_required and Sol reproduced distinct raw hashes and byte counts across the primary and exact-HEAD worker checkouts while normalized Git content remained equal.

correction.action: Freeze canonical LF UTF-8 hashing for bound text inputs, reject bare carriage returns, and verify the corrected source bindings in primary and clean worker or reviewer checkouts before occupied execution.

incidents.detection_method: The preserved complete serial pytest process reached 100 percent and exited 1 with one exact recurring-pattern list difference after the register validator, all population fixtures and all convergence-review tests passed.
