incidents.detection_method: The preserved complete serial pytest process reached 100 percent and exited 1 with one list-equality failure. Direct inspection showed the actual and expected detached-verifier rows were identical and the preceding population row had been filtered only from the actual side.

correction.action: Remove only the population-fixture signature from the actual-side exclusion set so its existing exact row remains aligned, advance totals, regenerate the report and rerun the complete packet.
correction.prevention_control: When splitting an owned recurrence assertion from an exact residual list, edit the filter set and expected residual rows as one paired change; otherwise leave both intact even if an additional explicit assertion is useful.

incidents.expected_invariant: The compact Current Baton register fixture must require the accepted current correction chain rather than permanently pin superseded historical incident names after the row advances.
incidents.observed_error: The first compact handover/baton/register packet failed one assertion because the accepted register row named AER-0405 through AER-0410 while the fixture still required historical AER-0399 and AER-0401 to remain in the one-line live handover.
incidents.detection_method: The preserved complete serial pytest process reached 100 percent and exited 1 only at test_live_baton_rows_accept_behavior_and_resume_narrow_product_work; compactness and the full register suite passed.

correction.action: Advance the live row to revision 360 and 411 incidents, name AER-0405 through AER-0411, replace the fixture's historical-name assertions with the current chain endpoints, regenerate the report and rerun the full compact packet.
correction.prevention_control: Current Baton prose fixtures require current revision/count and current bounded-chain endpoints; historical incident continuity belongs in the canonical register and revision documents, not as permanent names in the compact live row.

incidents.expected_invariant: A focused incident test must assert the exact stable phrase encoded in the accepted register and must not invent a near-synonym for natural-language correction prose.
incidents.observed_error: The fifth complete register-focused packet failed one newly authored AER-0411 assertion because it expected current correction-chain endpoints while the accepted prevention control says current bounded-chain endpoints.
incidents.detection_method: The preserved complete serial pytest process reached 100 percent and exited 1 only at test_aer_0411_records_compact_baton_historical_name_fixture_drift; every register validator, baton, handover and convergence-review assertion otherwise passed.

correction.action: Replace the invented near-synonym with the exact stable phrase current bounded-chain endpoints, add an explicit recurrence-group assertion, advance totals, regenerate the report and rerun the complete packet.
correction.prevention_control: Copy exact stable prose from the incident when a literal phrase is intentionally tested; otherwise assert structured fields or a shorter material token rather than inventing equivalent wording.

incidents.expected_invariant: A Continuity closeout must atomically rebind the live Compass and Current Baton fixtures to the accepted node, preserve the exact successor boundary and keep AGENTS.md below its compactness limit.
incidents.observed_error: The first closeout packet failed five assertions because the Compass and Current Baton fixtures still pinned the predecessor node and prose after the accepted graph advance, while the newly expanded live handover measured 81695 bytes against the less-than-80000-byte guard. The direct compactness recheck then failed because eight already-live current product-lineage rows were absent from the active-label classification. The next full packet failed one remaining fixture that required the superseded compound phrase explicit-confirmation cancellation after compaction retained the material cancellation token.
incidents.detection_method: The preserved complete provider-free pytest packet reached 100 percent with 397 passes and exited 1 on exactly one Compass assertion, three Current Baton assertions and one acceptance-index compactness assertion. The preserved direct compact check then exited 2 on the active-label mismatch. The preserved next full packet exited 1 only on the remaining cancellation-prose fixture; no product source, publication or successor execution followed.

correction.action: Rebind the current Compass and baton fixtures to Continuity 315 / Compass 297 and the exact adapter-extraction successor, compact the live baton below 80000 bytes, align script and manifest active-label classifications for all current lineage rows, replace the remaining superseded compound-prose fixture with its material cancellation token, advance register totals, regenerate the report and rerun the complete closeout packet.
correction.prevention_control: Treat graph/Compass advance, current-row fixtures, active-label classification and the live-handover byte budget as one closeout change set; measure and run the compactness check before the first full closeout packet and bind assertions to the new node and exact successor in the same patch.

incidents.expected_invariant: A complete active-operation latch must set resume_after_compaction false, next_executable_stage null, user attention false and terminal permission true.
incidents.observed_error: The first terminal latch transition changed status to complete but retained resume_after_compaction true and a non-null publication/successor stage, repeating the previously corrected AER-0390 pattern. The fresh full packet then found that the new explicit AER-0390/AER-0414 recurrence assertion had not been paired with exclusion of that signature from the residual recurrence list.
incidents.detection_method: The pure active-operation validator raised complete state is internally inconsistent in both canonical latch suites. After the terminal fields were corrected, the preserved full packet exited 1 only on the unpaired residual recurrence list; no closeout commit, push, notification or successor opening used either rejected state.

correction.action: Set resume_after_compaction false and next_executable_stage null while retaining accepted completion evidence, no user attention and terminal permission; pair the explicit recurrence assertion with exclusion from the residual list; then rerun both latch suites and the full closeout packet before commit.
correction.prevention_control: Construct every terminal latch transition from the exact status branch in orchestration_harness/active_operation.py and run both canonical latch suites before generating the final precommit receipt. When adding an explicit recurrence assertion, update its residual-list exclusion in the same patch.

incidents.expected_invariant: A completed active-operation latch checkpoint must name the final accepted register revision, incident population and closeout-packet result before the successor rehydration receipt can pass.
incidents.observed_error: The published completed latch still named register revision 362 and the 403-check packet after accepted closeout evidence had advanced through AER-0414 to revision 363, 414 incidents and a 404-check packet.
incidents.detection_method: Fresh five-source successor rehydration compared the completed latch with the accepted closeout, live Current Baton and canonical register before generating a pre-sprint-planning receipt; no successor plan, dispatch or product edit followed the mismatch.

correction.action: Update the completed-stage text to register revision 364, 415 incidents and the 404-check packet; bind those facts in the latch Continuity test, regenerate the register report and rerun the exact latch/register/baton packet before successor planning.
correction.prevention_control: Immediately before terminal latch commit, derive completed-stage revision, population and check-count facts from the final register/closeout objects and assert them in the latch Continuity suite; do not copy them from an earlier precommit checkpoint.

incidents.expected_invariant: A post-publication evidence correction must use the register schema vocabulary and its focused continuity assertion must resolve the canonical latch path before the corrected state can be committed.
incidents.observed_error: The first AER-0415 correction used the schema-invalid stage pre_sprint_planning and added a latch assertion that referenced undefined CURRENT_LATCH. Register report generation rejected the stage and the preserved focused pytest packet exited with the schema failures and NameError before commit. The next generator pass rejected an informal AER-0415 related-incident link because no exact attempt-peer linkage existed.
incidents.detection_method: The register generator failed JSON-schema validation before writing a new report, and the complete focused latch/register/baton packet then reached 100 percent with the corresponding register failures plus the undefined-name failure. After those repairs, the generator failed closed on the attempt-peer linkage rule. No commit, successor receipt, dispatch or product edit followed.

correction.action: Map AER-0415 to the accepted closeout stage, define CURRENT_LATCH once at module scope, remove the unsupported informal related-incident link, add exact AER-0416 coverage, advance revision and aggregate fixtures, regenerate the report and rerun the complete focused packet before commit or successor planning.
correction.prevention_control: Before adding an incident or focused latch assertion, select stage values from the register schema, resolve every newly referenced module symbol and add related-incident links only with the exact required attempt-peer linkage; run register generation before the wider focused packet so contract defects are isolated immediately.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every continuation receipt must express lane leverage using the exact admitted vocabulary before worker dispatch can be permitted.
incidents.observed_error: The first successor preplanning runtime state used high for the DeepSeek and Gemini expected-leverage fields. Preflight rejected both labels because the admitted values are positive, required_independence, neutral and negative.
incidents.detection_method: The fresh five-source orchestrator preflight returned revision_required with exactly parallelism_lane_leverage_invalid:deepseek_flash and parallelism_lane_leverage_invalid:gemini_verifier; worker_dispatch_permitted was false and no plan, worker or provider action followed.

correction.action: Replace DeepSeek leverage high with positive and Gemini leverage high with required_independence, advance register aggregates, regenerate the report and rerun the exact fresh five-source preplanning receipt before plan freeze or dispatch.
correction.prevention_control: Select every parallelism disposition and leverage label directly from orchestration/harness_settings/orchestrator_requirements.yaml when authoring a continuation runtime state; preflight remains mandatory before dispatch.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every assigned worker must have an explicit clean exact-branch workspace receipt before pre-dispatch can authorize launch.
incidents.observed_error: The first pre-dispatch runtime state assigned canonical_check_in_product_adapter_worker but left workspace_receipts empty. Preflight returned workspace_receipt_missing:canonical_check_in_product_adapter_worker and forbade dispatch.
incidents.detection_method: The exact pre_worker_dispatch orchestrator receipt returned revision_required and worker_dispatch_permitted false before the DeepSeek launcher was invoked.

correction.action: Add the exact assigned agent id, worktree, branch, clean state, current-handoff assertion and timestamp to workspace_receipts, advance register aggregates, regenerate the report and rerun pre-dispatch before launch.
correction.prevention_control: When assigned_agent_ids is non-empty, create one complete workspace_receipt for every exact agent id in the same runtime-state patch and verify the worktree source and cleanliness before preflight.

incidents.expected_invariant: A bounded implementation-and-test worker dispatch must return one preserved terminal result or fail as a sanitized non-result while leaving its exact isolated worktree unchanged before any source can be admitted.
incidents.observed_error: The occupied DeepSeek V4 Flash/high launch exited 1 after producing no terminal worker receipt, diagnostic stderr, owned file or commit. The exact worker branch remained clean at frozen plan source 2b20e59c4a6c6584709f794e7ed4b5e6b1dc5b0b.
incidents.detection_method: The launcher returned a nonzero terminal status, the expected receipt and both owned paths were absent, and Sol re-read the isolated branch, exact HEAD and empty worktree status before retaining the unchanged frozen package.

correction.action: Preserve the sanitized transport non-result, verify the exact isolated branch and HEAD remained clean, prohibit late worker-source adoption and let Sol implement the unchanged frozen two-file package without a same-lane retry.
correction.prevention_control: After a recurrent DeepSeek exit-1 non-result, exact receipt-path, owned-path, HEAD and worktree readback are mandatory; a bounded Sol fallback may use only the already frozen package and Gemini independence remains required before acceptance.

incidents.expected_invariant: A provider-free no-conftest admission packet must include only self-contained static tests and must not reuse a separately bounded known-negative suite as candidate acceptance evidence.
incidents.observed_error: The first broader Sol packet included two route suites that require repository database fixtures and the already documented route-literal endpoint-coverage false-positive suite. The no-conftest runner therefore reported 18 missing-fixture errors and eight unrelated static failures although the adapter-focused checks had passed.
incidents.detection_method: The failure output named the absent client/db fixtures and the same route-literal and moved-delete-route assertions already classified by the frozen convergence review. Sol confirmed none referenced either new adapter-owned file.

correction.action: Replace the over-broad packet with the literal self-contained API subset, preserve the rejected selection and run the repository-owned canonical fast profile separately before candidate commit.
correction.prevention_control: Before a no-conftest dispatch, inspect every selected file for repository fixtures and known-negative classification; fixture-backed coverage belongs only to an explicitly authorised database profile and documented negative suites cannot become positive admission gates.

incidents.expected_invariant: A yielded canonical verification run is admissible only when its unified-session identifier is retained and polled to an exact terminal exit with complete output.
incidents.observed_error: The first canonical-fast wrapper printed only the partial stdout field from the yielded exec result and discarded its session identifier. Although the process later disappeared, its terminal exit and remaining output were unavailable and were not admitted.
incidents.detection_method: The initial call returned after the 30-second yield without terminal output; process readback later showed completion, while no retained session handle existed for an exact exit-code read.

correction.action: Rerun the exact unchanged canonical command once, retain session 38174 and poll it to exit code 0 with all 200 tests and the remaining repository checks passing.
correction.prevention_control: Whenever exec_command can yield, serialize or otherwise retain the complete result object including session_id; never project only stdout until terminal exit is confirmed.

incidents.expected_invariant: An incident-register correction must advance every exact aggregate fixture and keep the active-operation checkpoint within its admitted 500-character bound before candidate commit.
incidents.observed_error: The first revision-369 focused packet failed two checks: the transport-separation fixture retained 291 agent-behavior incidents rather than 293, and the updated latch completed_stage contained 528 characters against the validator's 500-character maximum.
incidents.detection_method: The complete provider-free register/latch/baton/adapter packet failed only the exact aggregate assertion and validate_active_operation bounded-text check before candidate staging or commit.

correction.action: Advance the exact agent-behavior and total aggregates, shorten the latch checkpoint below 500 characters without dropping gate counts, add exact AER-0422 coverage, regenerate the pattern report and rerun the complete focused packet.
correction.prevention_control: After adding multiple incidents, derive every aggregate from the regenerated report and measure every bounded continuity field before running the full focused packet.

incidents.expected_invariant: A shortened valid latch checkpoint and its focused test must use the same compact semantic phrase before candidate staging.
incidents.observed_error: The revision-370 focused packet passed every check except one successor-latch assertion: it expected canonical fast profile passes 200 while the valid shortened checkpoint said 200-test canonical fast profile. The first correction then compressed AER-0422 and AER-0423 as AER-0422/0423, which still omitted the exact AER-0423 prefix required by that fixture.
incidents.detection_method: Two successive complete focused packets each returned one exact prose assertion failure and no register, latch-schema, product or adapter failure.

correction.action: Bind the focused assertion to 200-test canonical fast profile, spell both AER-0422 and AER-0423 prefixes explicitly, retain the checkpoint below 500 characters and rerun the complete focused packet.
correction.prevention_control: When compacting a bounded continuity field, update semantic fixtures from the final validated string rather than an intermediate draft.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every completed Antigravity transport whose output fails exact terminal-decision admission must write a sanitized digest-only egress-failure receipt before the run returns nonzero.
incidents.observed_error: The first Gemini 3.7 Flash/high veto transport returned exit zero but no schema-valid decision envelope. The harness rejected the result with observed 0 yet wrote no failure receipt because digest-only persistence covered nonzero transport exits but not post-transport egress admission failures.
incidents.detection_method: The wrapper reached parse_structured_decision, returned the exact zero-envelope error, left the review worktree clean at 8de886c5148b3259428c8c517674f10ea92d937e and created no configured output path; the code path inspection confirmed the missing post-transport exception receipt.

correction.action: Wrap both structured and legacy terminal-decision admission in a digest-only failure-receipt boundary, record exact transport/model/worktree identity plus stdout and stderr digests without raw output, distinguish verifier failure from transport failure at the CLI and add missing/conflicting egress regressions.
correction.prevention_control: Every Antigravity path after provider process completion must terminate in exactly one admitted worker receipt or one sanitized transport/egress failure receipt; no parse or decision-count exception may bypass evidence persistence.

incidents.expected_invariant: A provider-free verifier command manifest may contain only self-contained no-conftest tests, and its preflight must bind the repository's canonical parsed-manifest digest rather than a raw file-byte digest.
incidents.observed_error: The first admitted Gemini decision was revision_required only because C03 combined four self-contained provider-free suites with tests/test_model_required_bureau_a5_1_check_in_runtime.py, whose practice fixture is intentionally unavailable under the no-conftest runner. The manually authored preflight also named the raw JSON file SHA-256 instead of command_manifest_sha256 over the parsed manifest.
incidents.detection_method: Gemini reported that the adapter's substantive authority, idempotency, waiting-area, atomicity and patient-free challenges passed, while exact C03 alone exited 1 at missing fixture setup. Removing the fixture-dependent member made the unchanged four-suite command pass 101/101; canonical manifest hashing then produced 09b93f00ffd2c72f326ac0992de5927ca1397aae6ea972ee2cf1f7f00680c907.

correction.action: Remove the fixture-dependent A5.1 runtime suite from the no-conftest manifest, retain the four exact self-contained adapter/plan/convergence suites, reproduce their 101/101 pass locally at unchanged candidate HEAD and replace the preflight digest with command_manifest_sha256 over the parsed corrected manifest.
correction.prevention_control: Verifier manifest construction must classify every pytest path as self-contained or conftest-required before selection and obtain the digest only through load_command_manifest plus command_manifest_sha256; raw JSON file hashing is not an admitted substitute.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every full Git object ID used for worktree creation must be copied literally from a successful git rev-parse readback; a display prefix must never be manually expanded.
incidents.observed_error: Sol manually expanded plan prefix 4daa2d77 into nonexistent object 4daa2d77a575c098b7d09e2ff01fd6bd74dfc7e9 in the first worker-worktree command. Git returned invalid reference before creating a path, branch or worktree. No worker, provider, database, product or network action occurred.
incidents.detection_method: The git worktree add process returned invalid reference. Immediate path and branch checks proved absence; a standalone git rev-parse HEAD returned exact plan source 4daa2d772ffcf64e55f69917d2fb21802e959673, from which the corrected clean worktree was created.

correction.action: Capture literal git rev-parse HEAD output, use exact 4daa2d772ffcf64e55f69917d2fb21802e959673 for worktree creation and verify the new branch, path, clean status and HEAD before dispatch.
correction.prevention_control: Treat full Git identities as command outputs only. Every future worktree command must consume a separately captured literal git rev-parse value or an already machine-validated durable field; no manual completion of display prefixes is admitted.

incidents.expected_invariant: A bounded implementation-and-test worker dispatch must return one preserved terminal result or fail as a sanitized non-result while leaving its exact isolated worktree unchanged before any source can be admitted.
incidents.observed_error: The occupied DeepSeek V4 Flash/high launch exited 1 after producing no terminal worker result, diagnostic stderr, owned file or commit. The exact worker branch remained clean at frozen plan source 4daa2d772ffcf64e55f69917d2fb21802e959673.
incidents.detection_method: The launcher returned a nonzero terminal status, the expected result artifact was absent, and Sol re-read the isolated branch, exact HEAD and empty worktree status before retaining the unchanged frozen package.

correction.action: Preserve the sanitized transport non-result, verify the exact isolated branch and HEAD remained clean, prohibit late worker-source adoption and let Sol implement the unchanged frozen package under an explicit recovery lease without a same-lane retry.
correction.prevention_control: After a recurrent DeepSeek exit-1 non-result, exact result-path, owned-path, HEAD and worktree readback are mandatory; a bounded Sol fallback may use only the already frozen package and Gemini independence remains required before acceptance.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every Ariadne parallelism lane must use one exact configured disposition value before a continuation receipt may pass.
incidents.observed_error: Sol labelled the completed DeepSeek transport lane contained_transport_non_result, which is descriptive but outside the configured disposition vocabulary. The candidate-precommit preflight returned revision_required before commit, dispatch or provider action.
incidents.detection_method: The local Ariadne preflight emitted parallelism_lane_disposition_invalid:deepseek_flash; the corrected state used completed with an explicit preserved-non-result work package and the distinct regenerated receipt passed.

correction.action: Replace contained_transport_non_result with admitted disposition completed, retain the exact preservation-and-closure work package and require a distinct passing candidate-precommit receipt before commit.
correction.prevention_control: Select lane dispositions only from orchestration/harness_settings/orchestrator_requirements.yaml and place descriptive terminal detail in rationale and work_packages rather than inventing an enum value.

incidents.expected_invariant: Each validation, staging, commit and readback gate must execute as one independently captured process so a later command cannot mask an earlier nonzero exit.
incidents.observed_error: Sol used semicolon-composed PowerShell invocations for several pre-candidate checks and one staging/commit boundary. Although the checks passed and no masked failure was observed, a later command could have hidden an earlier validation exit.
incidents.detection_method: Sol reviewed the tranche command history against the accepted no-chained-validation prevention control, classified the recurrence before verifier dispatch and reran every candidate admission gate as a separate process.

correction.action: Retain the exact candidate unchanged and rerun compilation, Ruff, diff check, focused adapter/convergence, database-backed A5.1, API-Spine/plan and full register gates as independently captured processes before Gemini dispatch.
correction.prevention_control: No validation, staging, commit or readback operation may share a shell invocation with another gate; record every exit before starting the next process.

incidents.expected_invariant: Repository package CLIs must be invoked through python -m so their package imports and admitted execution boundary are preserved, including help and read-only diagnostics.
incidents.observed_error: Sol invoked scripts/ariadne_antigravity.py by file path for --help. The process exited 1 with ModuleNotFoundError before any verifier or provider launch; the candidate and worktree remained unchanged.
incidents.detection_method: The direct process returned exit 1 and a package-import error. The immediately corrected python -m scripts.ariadne_antigravity --help process returned exit 0 and the supported CLI contract.

correction.action: Rerun the help command through python -m scripts.ariadne_antigravity, require exit 0 before constructing verifier evidence and retain the exact candidate unchanged.
correction.prevention_control: All repository package CLIs use python -m; file-path execution is prohibited even for help or read-only diagnostics.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every durable evidence timestamp must be copied from an immediate machine clock readback and must not claim a future local time.
incidents.observed_error: Sol manually estimated 13:35 and 13:44 timestamps for revision 377/378 evidence while the machine clock still read 13:22:34 Australia/Brisbane. The product candidate was unchanged and no verifier/provider had launched.
incidents.detection_method: An immediate Get-Date -Format o readback returned 2026-08-18T13:22:34.3122671+10:00 before packet authoring; Sol compared it to the four durable timestamp fields and corrected them before verifier dispatch.

correction.action: Replace all four manually estimated fields with the immediately machine-read Australia/Brisbane ISO-8601 timestamp before Gemini dispatch and retain the product candidate unchanged.
correction.prevention_control: Every durable evidence timestamp is copied from an immediately preceding machine clock readback; manual estimation is prohibited.

incidents.expected_invariant: No validation, staging, commit or readback operation may share a shell invocation with another gate; each exit must be independently captured before the next process starts.
incidents.observed_error: After resumption, Sol combined git status, four protected-ref readbacks and two exact-file metadata readbacks in one semicolon-composed PowerShell invocation. The combined process exited zero and showed the expected values, but it repeated the readback form of the AER-0429 control breach.
incidents.detection_method: Sol compared the first resumed command with the AER-0429 prevention control immediately after its output and rejected it as verifier-admission evidence before any provider dispatch.

correction.action: Retain the candidate unchanged, exclude the combined output from verifier admission and rerun every dispatch-critical readback as a separate process before Gemini launch.
correction.prevention_control: One process per validation, staging, commit or readback gate; semicolon-composed gate invocations are prohibited even when every operation is read-only.

incidents.expected_invariant: A continuity node must link every inherited contract-evidence path through one of its typed evidence buckets before accepted Compass state can be written.
incidents.observed_error: The first idempotent updater run wrote draft Continuity 317 / Compass 299 state and then failed Compass validation because inherited contract-evidence paths were not repeated in the new node's typed evidence buckets.
incidents.detection_method: The updater's built-in ariadne_compass validation returned explicit contract_evidence_path_not_node_evidence reasons and a nonzero exit before the closeout was admitted.

correction.action: Link every inherited contract path through the corresponding plan, finding, closeout and test bucket, then rerun the updater idempotently until its Compass report passes.
correction.prevention_control: Before each continuity update, compare every contract_evidence path with the union of the node's typed evidence buckets and require an empty difference before execution.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every requested test path must come from a repository-confirmed exact filename rather than an inferred maintenance-test name.
incidents.observed_error: Sol guessed nonexistent tests/test_ariadne_compass_current.py for an optional maintenance check. Pytest exited before collection.
incidents.detection_method: The independently captured pytest process returned file-or-directory-not-found and collected no tests.

correction.action: Exclude the nonexistent command from acceptance and use the updater's passing built-in Compass validator plus the exact new continuity test as the admitted evidence.
correction.prevention_control: Optional maintenance checks may run only when their exact filename is already present in an accepted plan, updater or Git-tracked evidence list; guessed filenames are prohibited.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every adapter observation method in an Ariadne runtime state must come from the configured method vocabulary.
incidents.observed_error: The first closeout precommit runtime state used invented adapter observation method antigravity_worker_receipt. Ariadne returned revision_required before commit.
incidents.detection_method: The independently captured preflight receipt returned adapter_probe_method_invalid:antigravity_cli_print and did not permit the closeout commit.

correction.action: Replace the invented method with configured synthetic_fixture, retain the durable Gemini receipt in the evidence field and require a fresh passed precommit receipt.
correction.prevention_control: Copy adapter observation methods only from a previously passing exact runtime state or the configured enum; receipt provenance belongs in evidence text, not the method value.

incidents.expected_invariant: A terminal latch checkpoint must name the complete accepted incident range current at its closeout.
incidents.observed_error: The pushed terminal latch checkpoint said AER-0426 through AER-0434 even though register revision 382 and the Current Baton accepted AER-0435.
incidents.detection_method: The successor's mandatory exact latch readback was compared with the Current Baton register row before a new operation latch was opened.

correction.action: Update the terminal checkpoint to name AER-0426 through AER-0435 before opening the successor latch.
correction.prevention_control: Compare the terminal latch's incident range with the Current Baton and canonical register latest id immediately before every closeout push and successor rehydration.

incidents.expected_invariant: Chunked mandatory-file reads must use the actual character length for substring bounds and must cover the file completely without an exception.
incidents.observed_error: The final chunked AGENTS.md read used the byte length as a character substring bound and exceeded the text by two characters, returning an exception.
incidents.detection_method: PowerShell returned a Substring bounds exception; a standalone character-length readback returned 80261 before the exact remaining chunk was read successfully.

correction.action: Read the text character length independently, then read the exact final 10261-character chunk and require complete coverage before planning.
correction.prevention_control: Chunk text by its independently read character length, never filesystem byte length; calculate each final bound from that value.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every agent-error register stage value must come from the schema enum before a full register build is attempted.
incidents.observed_error: The first AER-0437 register draft used unsupported stage value rehydration and failed schema validation.
incidents.detection_method: The independently captured full register build returned a jsonschema enum failure before the draft was accepted.

correction.action: Use configured stage dispatch for AER-0437's preplanning continuation boundary and require a fresh complete register build.
correction.prevention_control: Copy incident stage only from the register schema enum before authoring; explanatory lifecycle detail belongs in detection text.

incidents.expected_invariant: Pinned-package discovery must use a resolution context that actually exposes the installed npx package or an exact registry field.
incidents.observed_error: The probe npx -p @deepseek-ai/dsh node -p require.resolve(...) executed Node outside the package's resolvable module context and returned MODULE_NOT_FOUND.
incidents.detection_method: The no-provider discovery command exited nonzero before any harness or model invocation.

correction.action: Use exact npm view fields for version, shasum, integrity and tarball, plus the pinned CLI's own --version output.
correction.prevention_control: Do not assume npx -p mutates the child Node module search path; prefer package-manager metadata and the executable's own version contract.

incidents.expected_invariant: Package metadata discovery must request only the exact bounded fields required for evidence.
incidents.observed_error: A broad npm view JSON query exceeded the available output context and was truncated.
incidents.detection_method: The tool reported output truncation before the broad result was admitted.

correction.action: Read version, dist.shasum, dist.integrity and dist.tarball in four independently bounded commands.
correction.prevention_control: Name one npm metadata field per evidence command; never request the full package document when four scalars suffice.

incidents.expected_invariant: Windows ripgrep searches must use existing literal directory operands and bounded globs or exact files.
incidents.observed_error: Several searches passed dsh-* as a Windows path operand, which is invalid, and one later replacement regex searched too broadly and produced a very large truncated result.
incidents.detection_method: Ripgrep returned Windows filename errors on the wildcard operands, and the broad replacement query reported output truncation.

correction.action: Search the exact @deepseek-ai directory with rg --glob or read the exact package README/source file.
correction.prevention_control: On Windows, keep path operands literal and existing; express file selection only through rg globs and bound content queries to the owning package.

incidents.expected_invariant: A non-Git disposable provider process must not be represented as an assigned Git agent worktree in the orchestrator receipt.
incidents.observed_error: The first receipt lacked the required workspace agent_id, and the second marked the non-Git workspace as not at handoff; both correctly returned revision_required.
incidents.detection_method: Fresh preflight receipts returned workspace_receipt_missing and workspace_not_at_handoff reason codes before dispatch permission was granted.

correction.action: Keep the native Harness process represented by its DeepSeek lane and worker slot without assigned_agent_ids or a Git workspace receipt.
correction.prevention_control: Use workspace receipts only for actual assigned Git agents; provider processes in isolated non-Git directories remain lane evidence.

incidents.expected_invariant: Provider dispatch may be admitted only after the exact composed configuration passes runtime boot validation, not merely static dump composition.
incidents.observed_error: The package preflight claimed occupied_request_permitted after --dump-config, but the sole provider-capable process exited during plugin-tree load because retryPolicy.retryableCodes was empty.
incidents.detection_method: The process returned exit 1, zero stdout and exact stderr hash; a key-absent diagnostic reproduced the same adapter boot invariant before provider I/O, and no sessions directory existed.

correction.action: Record the result as bounded_no_provider_call_configuration_failure, perform no retry or fallback, preserve sanitized metadata, and close without a model-performance claim.
correction.prevention_control: Future native-Harness dispatch requires a credential-absent exact-profile boot probe before any provider-capable process; static config dump alone is insufficient.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every full source_head written to continuity evidence must come from an exact independent git rev-parse readback.
incidents.observed_error: One latch draft expanded short commit output 7f878a8e into an invented full object id instead of reading the object.
incidents.detection_method: An immediate standalone git rev-parse HEAD returned 7f878a8e9795b4b82f16a50cf6315ecc293f5da1 and the latch was corrected before acceptance.

correction.action: Replace the draft value with exact git rev-parse HEAD output before the latch is staged.
correction.prevention_control: Never expand or infer a short SHA; run git rev-parse independently for every full object-id field.

incidents.expected_invariant: Exact disposable cleanup must complete through an allowed, verified and preferably recoverable filesystem operation.
incidents.observed_error: After exact path and parent verification, the direct Remove-Item recursive cleanup command was rejected by command policy.
incidents.detection_method: The command runner returned a policy rejection before deletion; the target remained available for safe recovery.

correction.action: Send the already verified exact directory to the Windows Recycle Bin and independently read back its absence.
correction.prevention_control: Prefer the recoverable Windows Recycle Bin API for disposable-directory cleanup after exact parent and leaf verification.

incidents.expected_invariant: PowerShell multi-command readback must use actual script lines or independent invocations, never a literal newline marker embedded in one token.
incidents.observed_error: Two read-only command drafts passed a literal newline marker into git status and ConvertFrom-Json, so both failed before their intended readback.
incidents.detection_method: Git reported an unknown combined option and PowerShell reported a combined ConvertFrom-Json command name; corrected independent invocations then passed.

correction.action: Run the Git refs and receipt parsing as independent bounded commands or actual multiline PowerShell source.
correction.prevention_control: Do not encode shell newlines through a host-language escape whose interpretation is uncertain; prefer one command per tool invocation for gates.

incidents.expected_invariant: A long-running package bootstrap wrapper must preserve the returned process/session handle required for ordinary bounded waiting.
incidents.observed_error: The first npx wrapper emitted only output and exit fields, so its still-running session handle was not retained while the large official dependency tree resolved.
incidents.detection_method: The wrapper returned without a visible exit code while an exact npx child process and advancing npm registry log remained observable.

correction.action: Observe the exact child process and npm-log progress read-only, let the bootstrap finish, then preserve the full result object from a cached offline version invocation.
correction.prevention_control: For potentially long commands, emit or store the complete exec result including session_id before the orchestration wrapper exits.

incidents.expected_invariant: A custom sandbox and approval combination must be represented by an explicit named permission preset before runtime admission.
incidents.observed_error: The first key-absent runtime boot rejected workspace-write plus never approval because the composed defaults matched no named preset.
incidents.detection_method: The native Harness exited 1 during permission plugin load before credential resolution or HTTP I/O and named the missing defaultPreset invariant.

correction.action: Define explicit rehearsal-write preset pairing workspace-write sandbox with never approval and select it as the default.
correction.prevention_control: Treat named session-pinned presets as the unit of permission admission; never rely on an unnamed cross-product of independent defaults.

incidents.expected_invariant: Five-source EMR4 Git evidence must not present a separately rooted synthetic repository object as an EMR4-resolvable full object id.
incidents.observed_error: The first pre-dispatch source prose included the synthetic repository's full commit id, and the receipt correctly returned git_refs_evidence_object_unresolvable.
incidents.detection_method: The generated receipt failed closed before worker dispatch and named the unresolvable Git evidence object.

correction.action: Keep the full foreign commit in its dedicated evidence and use a labelled short foreign id in the five-source prose.
correction.prevention_control: Full 40-hex object ids in orchestrator Git prose must belong to and resolve in the active repository unless the schema carries explicit foreign-repository identity.

incidents.expected_invariant: A request-counting transport guard must persist request admission before forwarding so every ordinal remains attributable even if an SSE response never reaches its observed end callback.
incidents.observed_error: The guard recorded provider response terminals for ordinals 1 and 3-6 plus local rejection 7, but no terminal for ordinal 2 and no independent request-start records.
incidents.detection_method: Proxy metadata had an ordinal gap while the durable Harness session contained six successful assistant usage anchors and the counter rejected ordinal 7.

correction.action: Bind current request accounting through six durable assistant usage anchors and preserve the proxy gap; add a pre-forward body-admitted request-start record to any future counter.
correction.prevention_control: Transport guards log request admission before forwarding and record client-close/abort separately from upstream end.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every Ariadne runtime state must copy the exact current continuation-event vocabulary before receipt generation; the preplanning event is pre_sprint_planning.
incidents.observed_error: The first successor preplanning runtime state reused the prose abbreviation pre_plan. Orchestrator preflight returned revision_required with continuation_event_missing_or_unapproved and admitted none of the five-source evidence.
incidents.detection_method: The failed receipt returned revision_required before plan commit, worker dispatch, provider I/O or external mutation. The orchestrator listed the configured vocabulary, corrected the runtime state to pre_sprint_planning and generated a distinct passed five-source receipt.

correction.action: Preserve the rejected receipt, list the configured continuation events, correct the runtime state to pre_sprint_planning and admit only the distinct passed five-source receipt before freezing the plan.
correction.prevention_control: Before creating any runtime state, run the orchestrator preflight continuation-event listing and copy one exact configured value; never infer a shortened machine event from prose.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every exact source identity in the active-operation latch must be copied from a standalone machine git rev-parse result and resolve in the active repository.
incidents.observed_error: The latch manually expanded the visible plan-commit prefix as bb6d9c659853eff866cfc6327ad3f84e958361cd, while standalone git rev-parse HEAD returned bb6d9c65910c2464dd1cfb5bfe087984f3d8a583.
incidents.detection_method: A fresh standalone git rev-parse HEAD followed by an exact-string repository search found the incorrect identity only in the live latch. No dispatch, provider request, candidate adoption or protected-ref movement used it.

correction.action: Replace both latch occurrences with the literal standalone git rev-parse HEAD output before any continuation receipt or worker dispatch.
correction.prevention_control: Copy all 40-character Git identities only from separately captured machine output and immediately verify repository resolution; never extend a displayed prefix manually.

incidents.expected_invariant: An occupied native-Harness profile may claim host-path and credential isolation only when package-source semantics and the execution enclosure technically enforce those read boundaries.
incidents.observed_error: The frozen plan treated a sparse host worktree, workspace-write filesystem mode and process-environment credential as a read and credential boundary. Pinned rc.7 documentation states that filesystem reads always pass through and that same-UID credential secrecy is discretion, not a boundary.
incidents.detection_method: Sol inspected the exact installed rc.7 dsh-fs-sandbox and dsh-credentials-local package sources after provider-free composition. The credential-absent boot reached MISSING_CREDENTIAL, and no occupied provider request or worker dispatch had occurred.

correction.action: Freeze a two-container enclosure: mount only the exact sparse worktree into a no-egress Harness worker with no model-facing shell or provider credential, and keep the real key in a separate authenticated broker sidecar with no shared mount.
correction.prevention_control: Map package-source read, write, process, network and credential semantics before occupied dispatch; a workspace-write label never implies a read or secret boundary without an independent OS/container enclosure.

incidents.expected_invariant: Adding a read-only disposable container root filesystem to the already isolated provider-free preflight should preserve the headless profile's disabled HMR entry and reach MISSING_CREDENTIAL.
incidents.observed_error: Three read-only-rootfs probes exited during plugin load because rc.7 applied the disabled cordis-plugin-hmr entry and required --expose-internals. Network mode was none; no credential, broker request, provider request or model step existed.
incidents.detection_method: The exact containers exited 1 with the same local HMR loader stack before credential resolution. The earlier minimum enclosure with a disposable writable container rootfs had already reached exact MISSING_CREDENTIAL under network none.

correction.action: Do not add the unrequired read-only-rootfs option to this rc.7 trial. Retain the minimum technical isolation: disposable worker rootfs, exact host mounts, no real provider credential, internal broker-only network and no model-facing shell.
correction.prevention_control: Provider-free boot-test every container hardening option against the pinned Harness package before admission; an optional hardening failure cannot be bypassed with a broader runtime flag when the minimum isolation boundary does not require it.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every validation and readback gate must run as one separately captured process so a later command cannot mask an earlier exit.
incidents.observed_error: The orchestrator placed the AER-0454 location readback and JSON parse validation in one newline-separated PowerShell invocation, contrary to the standing one-process-per-gate control.
incidents.detection_method: Immediate self-review of the exact tool invocation found two commands in one shell process. Both outputs were read-only, the JSON validation passed and no candidate, provider, Docker or ref state changed.

correction.action: Preserve the incident and run every remaining readback, validation, generation, staging and commit gate through a distinct process invocation with its own exit result.
correction.prevention_control: One command and one result per process for all remaining gates; newline separation inside one shell invocation is prohibited just like semicolon or pipeline composition.

incidents.expected_invariant: The actual sparse-worker provider-free boot must use an exact rc.7-admitted DSH_TOOLS_MODE value and reach MISSING_CREDENTIAL before any occupied request.
incidents.observed_error: The first sparse-worker container supplied DSH_TOOLS_MODE=local. Pinned rc.7 admits only native, code or both, so plugin-tree validation stopped locally before credential resolution, broker traffic, provider traffic or a model step.
incidents.detection_method: The preserved container exited during dsh-tools configuration with an exact validation error naming the admitted vocabulary. The earlier passing provider-free container recorded DSH_TOOLS_MODE=native; one fresh corrected provider-free boot used that exact value and reached MISSING_CREDENTIAL with the worktree unchanged.

correction.action: Preserve the failed container, rebind DSH_TOOLS_MODE to exact previously passing value native, and consume the plan's single provider-free corrected boot before occupied dispatch.
correction.prevention_control: Copy every launcher environment enum from exact pinned-package validation or a separately captured passing container; do not infer an apparently descriptive value from prose.

incidents.expected_invariant: A pre-worker-dispatch runtime state must use only configured parallelism dispositions and must not mark a worker assigned before the required clean handoff-current workspace receipt phase is satisfied.
incidents.observed_error: The first receipt used unrecognised DeepSeek disposition selected and populated assigned_agent_ids before a handoff-current workspace receipt existed. Preflight returned revision_required with both exact reason codes and did not authorise dispatch.
incidents.detection_method: The failed receipt reported parallelism_lane_disposition_invalid:deepseek_flash and workspace_receipt_missing:deepseek-native-harness-emr4-profile-validator-worker-001 before broker start, provider I/O, model execution or candidate change.

correction.action: Preserve the rejected receipt, use exact configured disposition planned, keep assigned-agent and active-slot lists empty until actual dispatch, and generate a distinct corrected five-source receipt.
correction.prevention_control: Copy lane dispositions from the configured vocabulary and represent a not-yet-started external worker as planned with no assigned agent; never use a prose synonym or predeclare an active assignment.

incidents.expected_invariant: After AER-0455, every remaining readback and validation process must contain one command whose exit cannot be masked by a downstream pipeline command.
incidents.observed_error: The orchestrator subsequently used output-limiting PowerShell pipelines in readback calls, including rg output piped to Select-Object, despite AER-0455's explicit no-pipeline control.
incidents.detection_method: Immediate self-review of the exact readback invocation identified the pipeline. The calls were read-only and no worktree, Docker, provider, candidate or ref state changed.

correction.action: Stop all shell pipeline composition and run each remaining readback with a single native command or accept its full bounded output.
correction.prevention_control: For the remainder of this tranche, every shell process contains exactly one executable command with no pipe, semicolon or newline-composed successor; output limiting must use that executable's native options only.

incidents.expected_invariant: Exact pinned-package source mapping and provider-free composition must enumerate every model-facing tool schema before an occupied request, and the composed request must declare only read, glob and edit.
incidents.observed_error: The pre-dispatch mapping claimed that the enclosed worker exposed only read, glob and edit. The first occupied request actually declared seven tools: edit, glob, grep, read, read_image, str_replace_editor and write. The isolated broker rejected the request with tool-not-allowlisted before provider I/O.
incidents.detection_method: Broker logs recorded one tool-not-allowlisted rejection and zero provider-call-started events. Sanitized four-frame session reduction independently counted one request header with the exact seven tool names, zero usage records, zero tool calls and an INVALID_REQUEST HTTP 400 terminal. The sparse candidate remained unchanged.

correction.action: Preserve the terminal negative evidence, consume the tranche's single occupied attempt without retry, and require a separately frozen recovery tranche to prove a package-native scoped model tool view before any future occupied dispatch.
correction.prevention_control: Before every native-Harness occupied dispatch, reduce a provider-free composed request header and compare its exact ordered model-facing tool inventory with the frozen profile and broker allowlist; reject any hidden, aliased or surplus schema before credentialed provider routing.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every active-operation checkpoint field must satisfy the configured bounded-text limit before it is embedded in a continuation runtime state or submitted to Ariadne preflight.
incidents.observed_error: The first terminal-evidence precommit runtime copied a completed_stage checkpoint longer than the configured bound. Preflight returned revision_required with active_operation_latch_invalid and did not authorise commit.
incidents.detection_method: A standalone active-latch validation reported completed_stage must be bounded non-empty text. No Git staging, commit, provider call, runtime launch, candidate change or protected-ref movement occurred.

correction.action: Preserve the rejected receipt, shorten the checkpoint without changing its facts, validate the latch standalone, and generate a distinct corrected precommit receipt.
correction.prevention_control: Validate the active latch as its own gate after every checkpoint edit and before copying it into any continuation runtime state; never rely on preflight to be the first bounded-text check.

incidents.expected_invariant: A Continuity node must include every inherited contract evidence path in its own evidence inventory and every named test artifact must resolve before graph, Compass and rendered-report admission.
incidents.observed_error: The first Continuity updater omitted inherited contract paths from the node evidence inventory and named the profile-contract test with worker in the filename. Compass validation rejected the partially written revision 320 / 302 state before report rendering.
incidents.detection_method: The updater exited 1 with exact contract_evidence_path_not_node_evidence reasons and evidence_not_found for the misspelled test path. No provider, candidate, protected ref or external runtime changed; the updater's reentrant branch preserves deterministic correction.

correction.action: Preserve the failed updater evidence, add every inherited contract path to the node evidence inventory, correct the exact existing profile-test filename, and rerun through the updater's revision-320 reentrant branch.
correction.prevention_control: Before every Continuity updater run, mechanically compare the union of contract_evidence paths with the node evidence inventory and resolve every named artifact path; only then permit graph or Compass writes.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every inherited contract evidence type must be linked through the corresponding node evidence collection, including test evidence required by the inherited contract.
incidents.observed_error: The first reentrant correction added plan, finding and closeout contract paths but still omitted both inherited contract test paths. Compass validation rejected the state with contract_evidence_type_unlinked for tests.
incidents.detection_method: The second updater run exited 1 with two exact current_position_continuity contract_evidence_type_unlinked reasons. No provider, candidate, external runtime or protected ref changed; graph and Compass remained on the same reentrant 320 / 302 node.

correction.action: Add both exact inherited contract test paths to contract_evidence and the node tests inventory, then rerun the same reentrant updater without changing the accepted result.
correction.prevention_control: Validate inherited contract evidence by typed collection, not path union alone: every contract plan, finding, closeout, acceptance, receipt, test and artifact path must appear in the matching node evidence key before any Continuity write.

incidents.expected_invariant: The canonical Compass report test must assert the current accepted terminal node rather than a superseded historical programme position.
incidents.observed_error: The focused closeout packet passed 71 checks but tests/test_ariadne_compass.py still required the historical arrival/check-in convergence-review node. The same test was already stale at evidence source af1a79f93024a7186849e550b4d529c8c601c93f, whose committed current position was Continuity 319's native-Harness agentic-coding rehearsal.
incidents.detection_method: The serialized closeout packet reported exactly one failure at the literal current_position.node_id assertion while Compass schema/semantic validation and every current-tranche continuity, profile, broker and latch check passed.

correction.action: Update only the stale literal to the accepted Continuity 320 terminal node, preserve all Compass schema, semantic, horizon and lineage assertions, register the failure and rerun the serialized closeout packet.
correction.prevention_control: Every Continuity closeout that advances current_position must update and execute the canonical Compass current-node sentinel in the same closeout packet; baseline-check that literal before the updater write.

incidents.expected_invariant: A continuation runtime state's explicit parallelism assessment must name the same operation as its embedded active-operation latch during a predecessor-to-successor preplanning transition.
incidents.observed_error: The first successor preplanning runtime named the successor operation in parallelism_assessment while its embedded authoritative latch still described the completed predecessor. Preflight returned revision_required with parallelism_assessment_operation_mismatch.
incidents.detection_method: The immutable preplanning receipt records the exact reason and worker_dispatch_permitted false. No worker, provider, staging, commit or protected ref action occurred.

correction.action: Preserve the rejected receipt, bind the transition assessment to the still-current complete latch operation, and generate a distinct corrected receipt before successor latch replacement.
correction.prevention_control: Before every continuation preflight, compare active_operation.operation_id and parallelism_assessment.operation_id as a standalone transition check; change both only after the successor latch is validly replaced.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every in-progress latch must use the canonical terminal reason unfinished_authorized_operation and pass standalone validation before continuation evidence or dispatch.
incidents.observed_error: The first successor latch used operation_in_progress as terminal_response.reason. Standalone validation rejected it with in_progress terminal reason is invalid.
incidents.detection_method: The latch validator failed before continuation receipt generation, staging, commit, provider call or worker dispatch; the consolidated correction evidence preserves the exact reason.

correction.action: Replace the non-canonical reason with unfinished_authorized_operation and rerun standalone latch validation before any successor receipt.
correction.prevention_control: Materialize in-progress latch terminal fields from the validator's fixed canonical tuple rather than free text, then validate standalone immediately after every latch transition.

incidents.expected_invariant: After AER-0455 and AER-0458, every shell gate must invoke exactly one executable and must not use pipelines, newline-composed successors or semicolon-composed commands.
incidents.observed_error: A read-only rg file-list invocation was piped to Select-String while searching for agent-error-register artifacts, recurring on the prohibited pipeline form.
incidents.detection_method: Orchestrator self-review identified the literal pipeline immediately after the command. It only printed paths and its output was not used as acceptance or authority evidence.

correction.action: Discard the pipeline output as authority and return discovery to one executable per invocation using native rg glob/include arguments or one self-contained Node program.
correction.prevention_control: Reject any shell command text containing a PowerShell pipeline or multiple composed executables before launch; use one executable's own filtering arguments for every gate.

incidents.expected_invariant: Repository scripts that import root packages must be invoked with repository module context so deterministic validation runs rather than failing before its gate.
incidents.observed_error: Direct invocation of scripts/ariadne_active_operation_latch.py could not import orchestration_harness and exited with ModuleNotFoundError.
incidents.detection_method: The process terminal was immediate and provider-free. Module-form invocation through python -m scripts.ariadne_active_operation_latch then validated the exact same latch successfully.

correction.action: Invoke the validator through python -m scripts.ariadne_active_operation_latch from repository root and preserve that form for subsequent gates.
correction.prevention_control: Use module-form invocation for scripts importing repository-root packages unless the script explicitly bootstraps sys.path; verify help or import context before treating a direct path as canonical.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every new incident must use only canonical register stage and category values and the complete register must validate before its revision is accepted or rendered.
incidents.observed_error: Revision 403 assigned planning to AER-0464 through AER-0466, and rehydration plus configuration_error to AER-0467. The schema admits none of those values and rejected the register before report generation.
incidents.detection_method: The canonical register validator exited nonzero on the first invalid stage and produced no accepted pattern report. Source inspection then confirmed all admitted stage/category enums for the corrected representation completed in revision 405.

correction.action: Preserve rejected revision 403, reclassify the incidents with canonical deterministic_verification stages, preserve the later rejected revision 404, and complete validation in revision 405.
correction.prevention_control: Read and mechanically validate canonical enum values before adding incidents, then require the register validator to pass before updating AGENTS.md or describing a revision as accepted.

incidents.expected_invariant: Register related_incident_ids links only peer rows sharing one exact attempt_id, and every category must retain its canonical origin mapping.
incidents.observed_error: Revision 404 used related_incident_ids for historical cross-attempt lineage in AER-0465, AER-0466 and AER-0468. It also classified AER-0467 as operator_error while retaining agent_behavior origin. Semantic validation rejected the first linkage mismatch before report generation.
incidents.detection_method: The canonical validator exited nonzero with attempt peer linkage mismatch for AER-0465. Source readback established the exact peer-link and origin/category rules before revision 405.

correction.action: Preserve rejected revision 404, clear cross-attempt related IDs, classify AER-0467 as output_contract_violation with agent_behavior origin, add AER-0469, and validate revision 405.
correction.prevention_control: Use related_incident_ids only for multiple rows sharing one attempt_id; represent broader lineage in prose and recurrence signatures, and mechanically verify the category-origin map before validation.

incidents.expected_invariant: The complete register suite must bind literal revision and count sentinels to the current canonical register whenever a valid revision advances.
incidents.observed_error: After revision 405 and its pattern report validated, four tests still required revision 402, 463 incidents and 329 agent-origin incidents. The current valid values before this incident were revision 405, 469 and 335.
incidents.detection_method: The complete serialized register suite passed all structural and semantic checks and failed only the four literal revision/count assertions.

correction.action: Advance only the stale revision, total-incident and agent-origin literal sentinels to revision 406 values and rerun the complete register suite.
correction.prevention_control: Every accepted register revision must baseline-check and advance the canonical register revision, total-count and origin-count test literals before the complete suite is launched.

incidents.expected_invariant: A register revision must advance the full coupled test baseline: contiguous incident IDs, revision, total, origin, category and candidate-state counts.
incidents.observed_error: Revision 406 corrected four literals but omitted the contiguous ID range and full origin/category/candidate-state aggregate maps. The second complete suite failed only those stale baseline surfaces.
incidents.detection_method: The complete serialized suite reported the extra AER-0464 through AER-0470 IDs and changed origin counts after every register semantic check passed.

correction.action: Advance the entire coupled literal baseline set for revision 407 and rerun the complete suite.
correction.prevention_control: Treat the contiguous ID range, revision, total, origin, category and candidate-state maps as one atomic baseline update for every accepted register revision.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every recurrence created by a register revision must be explicitly asserted and included in the closed recurring-pattern sentinel.
incidents.observed_error: AER-0470 and AER-0471 formed a two-incident recurrence, but revision 407 did not assert that exact recurrence or add it to the sentinel's enumerated admitted set.
incidents.detection_method: The complete serialized suite failed only the recurring-pattern equality after all revision, ID, origin, category and candidate-state aggregate assertions passed.

correction.action: Assert the exact AER-0470 and AER-0471 recurrence, include its signature in the closed sentinel and advance the complete coupled revision-408 baselines.
correction.prevention_control: Before every accepted register revision, diff the complete recurring-pattern signature set and atomically update both exact recurrence assertions and the closed sentinel alongside all aggregate baselines.

incidents.expected_invariant: Windows rg searches must express filename filters with rg -g arguments rather than shell-style wildcard path operands that Windows rejects.
incidents.observed_error: The first profile-family source search passed wildcard path operands such as docs/deepseek-native-harness* directly to rg and exited with Windows filename syntax errors.
incidents.detection_method: The read-only command exited nonzero before returning search evidence; a fresh rg invocation using explicit -g filters succeeded.

correction.action: Discard the failed search and rerun rg with repository directories as paths and exact -g filename filters.
correction.prevention_control: On Windows, provide rg glob patterns only through -g and keep path operands literal directories or files.

incidents.expected_invariant: Documentation assertions must normalize Markdown whitespace before matching a phrase that may cross a line wrap.
incidents.observed_error: The new exact-tool-view contract test searched raw Markdown for a phrase split across two source lines and produced one false-negative assertion failure.
incidents.detection_method: The focused profile-contract suite reported one failure while source readback showed the exact semantic phrase across a newline.

correction.action: Normalize the plan with split-and-join before matching and rerun the complete focused profile-contract suite to seven passes.
correction.prevention_control: Use normalized whitespace for prose-semantic assertions and reserve raw substring checks for intentionally line-stable source tokens.

incidents.expected_invariant: Docker inspect templates must use functions available in Docker's documented Go-template surface.
incidents.observed_error: A sanitized inspect command attempted to use an unavailable dict template function and exited before producing enclosure metadata.
incidents.detection_method: Docker reported template parsing error function dict not defined; separate exact scalar and mounts templates then succeeded.

correction.action: Use supported scalar interpolation and json field templates in separate read-only inspect invocations.
correction.prevention_control: Limit Docker inspect templates to documented built-ins or parse full inspect JSON in one bounded host process before retaining sanitized fields.

incidents.expected_invariant: A pinned Linux Harness worker must receive dependencies installed for linux-x64, never a Windows-installed node_modules tree.
incidents.observed_error: The first isolated worker mounted the Windows discovery node_modules tree; Linux refused sharp and Koffi native modules before composing any request.
incidents.detection_method: The worker exited during plugin loading with exact linux-x64 sharp and Koffi errors; capture request count and provider calls both remained zero.

correction.action: Install exact rc.7 inside the pinned Linux image into a disposable package volume and prove sharp and Koffi load before remounting that volume read-only.
correction.prevention_control: Bind package preparation to the execution platform and require native optional-module readback before any isolated Harness boot.

incidents.expected_invariant: The local capture hostname configured in the Harness adapter must be an exact alias on the isolated Docker network before worker launch.
incidents.observed_error: The second isolated capture container was not assigned alias capture, so the worker terminated with TRANSPORT before any request reached the endpoint.
incidents.detection_method: The worker terminal was TRANSPORT, the capture remained ready with no request artifact, and both external/provider call counts remained zero.

correction.action: Destroy attempt 002, create a fresh internal network, attach the capture container with exact alias capture and rerun a fresh worker session.
correction.prevention_control: Read back capture readiness and its exact network alias before every provider-free worker launch.

incidents.expected_invariant: After a pre-request transport terminal, capture artifact reads must first test exact path existence because no request artifact is the expected state.
incidents.observed_error: The orchestrator directly read the absent capture.json after attempt 002 and produced an avoidable path-not-found diagnostic.
incidents.detection_method: Get-Content reported the exact disposable capture path absent; the absence itself agreed with zero requests and was not used as a passing proof.

correction.action: Treat the absent artifact as corroborating zero-request evidence and require Test-Path before future conditional capture reads.
correction.prevention_control: Gate reads of request-created artifacts on exact path existence whenever the preceding terminal may occur before request emission.

incidents.expected_invariant: Disposable Windows roots should use the recoverable recycle path when available and avoid a destructive form rejected by the local safety policy.
incidents.observed_error: After exact path resolution, the orchestrator attempted recursive Remove-Item and the execution policy rejected it before process creation.
incidents.detection_method: The tool returned an immediate policy rejection; the root remained present and no data was removed by that attempt.

correction.action: Send the already resolved exact disposable root to the Windows Recycle Bin with Microsoft.VisualBasic FileIO and verify Test-Path false.
correction.prevention_control: Prefer the recoverable Windows recycle API for disposable directory cleanup and reserve recursive Remove-Item for explicitly approved nonrecoverable cases.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every new incident must use only a canonical register stage before a revision is described as accepted.
incidents.observed_error: Revision 409 assigned cleanup to AER-0479, but cleanup is not an admitted register stage; schema validation rejected the representation before pattern generation.
incidents.detection_method: The canonical register validator exited nonzero and named the exact invalid stage on AER-0479.

correction.action: Preserve rejected revision 409, reclassify AER-0479 at canonical closeout stage, add AER-0480 and validate revision 410 before acceptance.
correction.prevention_control: Read the schema stage enum before adding an incident and run the canonical validator before updating AGENTS.md or a revision document to accepted status.

incidents.expected_invariant: Rows sharing one attempt identity and related peer linkage must preserve one exact transport identity.
incidents.observed_error: Revision 410 linked AER-0477 and AER-0478 under attempt exact-tool-view-container-002 while one row used Docker transport and the other local PowerShell; semantic validation rejected the split identity.
incidents.detection_method: The canonical register validator exited nonzero with split attempt identity mismatch before pattern generation.

correction.action: Preserve rejected revision 410, give the conditional capture read its own attempt identity, clear invalid cross-transport peer links, add AER-0481 and validate revision 411.
correction.prevention_control: Before linking register peers, compare the full attempt identity including transport; use separate attempts and prose lineage when any identity field differs.

incidents.expected_invariant: A newly added incident assertion must preserve the exact case of the canonical observed-error text or normalize both operands explicitly.

incidents.expected_invariant: Repository path discovery must use one executable per shell invocation and must not resume a shell pipeline.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every explicit repository path operand must be resolved from the current inventory before execution.

incidents.expected_invariant: A register revision must update every derived population fixture and make newly authored exact narrative assertions match the registered text before the complete suite runs.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every direct and aggregate recurrence fixture for a changed signature must advance atomically before the next complete register suite run.

incidents.expected_invariant: A patch to a repeated incident_count literal must include its recurrence signature as unique target context and must not alter a neighboring recurrence.

incidents.expected_invariant: A final veto may claim newly introduced evidence defects remain rejected only when the filter distinguishes the appended current node from inherited historical ancestors.

incidents.expected_invariant: Repository JSON containing Unicode must be read explicitly as UTF-8 in one-off Python inspection commands.

incidents.expected_invariant: related_incident_ids must be empty or have an exact symmetric peer link; recurrence grouping is derived from recurrence_signature instead.

correction.prevention_control: Verification commands must be emitted from a typed launcher profile rather than composed from remembered pytest conventions; unsupported options fail before execution.

incidents.expected_invariant: A register revision must update its contiguous ID range, population fixtures, aggregate dictionaries and committed generated report before the complete suite runs.

correction.prevention_control: The clockwork reducer must own contiguous IDs, populations, aggregate dictionaries, recurrence rows and the committed report as projections of one journal reading.

incidents.expected_invariant: A complete register fixture must include every newly recurring pattern or explicitly classify and assert it before comparison.

incidents.expected_invariant: A repeated incident_count patch must include its owning recurrence signature as unique context and preserve a neighboring sentinel.

correction.prevention_control: The typed reducer must address fields by stable recurrence identity; until adoption, repeated-value patches include the owning signature and an unchanged neighboring sentinel.

incidents.expected_invariant: A copied recurrence row must preserve the canonical generator's deterministic prevention-control order.

correction.action: Replace the copied prevention-control tail with the generator's exact deterministic order and rerun the complete suite.
correction.prevention_control: The clockwork reducer must emit recurrence rows in deterministic canonical order and tests must consume that projection without independently ordering its narrative fields.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every incident attempt_id is unique unless an explicit symmetric peer relationship represents the same attempt.

correction.prevention_control: The clockwork journal must allocate attempt identities monotonically and reject caller-supplied identifiers that collide with retained events.

incidents.expected_invariant: A patch to a repeated attempt_id must include the owning incident_id as unique target context and verify both target and sentinel before validation.

correction.prevention_control: Every repeated attempt-ID edit must be addressed by incident identity, with exact target and neighboring sentinel readback before validation; the clockwork allocator removes this edit class.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every generated recurrence family must be classified once and excluded from the residual comparison from the same report reading.
