incidents.detection_method: The complete suite reported one list difference at operator.python_path_read_text_utf8_encoding_omitted; counts, incident identities and all earlier recurrence assertions passed.

correction.action: Add one explicit generated UTF-8 recurrence assertion, exclude it from the residual comparison and advance the population recurrence projection.
correction.prevention_control: The clockwork reducer must derive new recurrence classifications and residual exclusions from one generated set; tests must not discover them sequentially through failing comparisons.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every explicit repository path operand must be resolved from the current inventory before execution.

incidents.expected_invariant: One apply_patch payload must contain at most one operation for each target path.

correction.prevention_control: The clockwork publisher owns one target operation per projection; until adoption, reject any patch manifest containing the same path more than once.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every Python file under scripts in a verifier command manifest must be invoked as a package module with python -m before provider dispatch.

correction.prevention_control: Generate verifier command manifests from the typed clockwork command vocabulary; until live adoption, require preflight to reject every Python file under scripts that is not launched with python -m before any provider call.

incidents.expected_invariant: Each git rev-parse --verify invocation must name exactly one revision and every required ref must be captured as its own scalar reading.

correction.prevention_control: The causal clock must expose a typed VerifyRef operation that emits exactly one git revision operand and one full-object reading per tick; until adoption, never batch operands behind git rev-parse --verify.

incidents.expected_invariant: Verifier worktree preflight must receive the exact configured codex/review- branch prefix rather than a task-specific narrower prefix.

incidents.detection_method: The preflight failed closed before any provider call and emitted the exact branch_prefix reason; the candidate and clean review worktree remained unchanged.

correction.action: Preserve the failed preflight and rerun against the unchanged candidate with exact branch prefix codex/review- before permitting provider dispatch.
correction.prevention_control: Generate verifier preflight arguments from the typed execution-policy enum; until adoption, copy branch_prefix exactly as codex/review- and never derive it from the branch name.

incidents.expected_invariant: When verifier preflight declares an external serial repository root, that root must be the exact clean review worktree used by the manifest's --repo-root binding.
incidents.observed_error: The second kernel verifier preflight supplied the primary checkout as --serial-repo-root even though the manifest correctly bound the external serialized pytest runner to the review worktree, so preflight rejected the cross-checkout root before provider dispatch.

correction.action: Bind --serial-repo-root to the exact review worktree named by --cwd and the manifest's --repo-root, then rerun preflight before provider dispatch.
correction.prevention_control: Generate cwd, serial_repo_root and manifest --repo-root from one typed review-worktree receipt so all three resolve to the same exact path; never substitute the primary checkout.

incidents.expected_invariant: A read-only verifier command manifest may verify committed evidence but must never execute a generator that writes tracked evidence inside the exact candidate worktree.
incidents.observed_error: The nine-command kernel veto manifest included the deterministic evidence generator as C06. The reviewer executed it in the clean Windows review worktree, rewriting line endings in the committed kernel report and evidence JSON and making the worktree dirty without changing HEAD or semantic content.
incidents.detection_method: The launcher rejected the review at its mandatory clean-worktree postcondition. Exact Git status named only the two generated evidence paths, while Git diff reported no semantic content change after line-ending normalization and HEAD remained 4204ec6348abb0f92b1a30314699d4a469fa860a.

correction.action: Preserve the failed review evidence, restore only the two known generated paths from exact candidate HEAD, replace C06 with a read-only Git diff postcondition, and rerun the exact worktree/manifest preflight before any bounded fresh veto.
correction.prevention_control: The future typed clockwork command vocabulary must classify manifest operations by filesystem effect and reject evidence generators from read-only verifier ticks; until adoption, verifier manifests inspect committed evidence and run only non-regenerative tests and static checks.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every completed Antigravity transport that fails terminal-decision admission or a read-only worktree postcondition must write one sanitized digest-only egress-failure receipt before the launcher returns nonzero.
incidents.observed_error: The completed kernel veto child process exited zero, but the worktree postcondition was dirty. The launcher raised before structured-decision parsing and before writing its configured output, so no harness-owned digest-only failure receipt captured stdout or stderr evidence.
incidents.detection_method: The launcher returned the exact modified-worktree exception, the configured output path was absent, the manual bounded receipt preserved the Git postcondition, and code inspection showed both worktree identity exceptions bypassed the existing post-transport egress-failure writer.

correction.action: Write a sanitized egress-failure receipt for every post-transport worktree root, branch, HEAD or dirty-state failure before raising, including only exact identity fields plus stdout and stderr digests rather than raw model output.
correction.prevention_control: Every Antigravity path after provider process completion must terminate in exactly one admitted worker receipt or one sanitized transport/egress failure receipt; worktree postcondition failures are part of the same exhaustive boundary.

incidents.expected_invariant: Rows sharing one attempt identity and related peer linkage must preserve one exact role and full transport identity; cross-role process lineage must use distinct attempts and prose rather than false peer linkage.
incidents.observed_error: Rejected register revision 514 linked AER-0594 as orchestrator and AER-0595 as verifier peers under check-in-admission-kernel-gemini-veto-001, so semantic validation rejected the split role identity before pattern generation.
incidents.detection_method: The canonical register generator exited nonzero with split attempt identity mismatch: check-in-admission-kernel-gemini-veto-001:role before any revised register, review retry, commit or acceptance.

correction.action: Preserve revision 514 as rejected, remove the false cross-role peer links, give the harness egress incident a distinct attempt identity, add AER-0596 and validate revision 515 before any fresh verifier dispatch.
correction.prevention_control: The typed clockwork register projection must derive attempt identity and peer eligibility together; until adoption, compare role, resource, model and transport before linking peers and use prose lineage whenever any identity field differs.

incidents.expected_invariant: A pre-verifier runtime state must use the configured parallelism disposition vocabulary; a verifier awaiting its bounded dispatch remains reserved until an admitted external receipt completes.

incidents.detection_method: The repository-local receipt reported exactly parallelism_lane_disposition_invalid:gemini_verifier, worker_dispatch_permitted false and no provider or model call from the rejected receipt.

correction.action: Preserve the rejected attempt-002 state and receipt, create a distinct attempt-003 state using the admitted reserved disposition, and require a passing five-source receipt before any bounded verifier retry.
correction.prevention_control: The typed clockwork continuation event must project verifier disposition from the configured enum and stage; until adoption, copy the reserved value from the last passing pre-verifier analogue and never infer selected.

incidents.expected_invariant: Every correction evidence path must exist before the canonical register validator runs; a planned future runtime state cannot serve as current correction evidence.

correction.action: Preserve rejected revision 516, replace the future path with the existing revision-516 rejection document, add AER-0598 and validate revision 517 before authoring the corrected attempt-003 continuation state.
correction.prevention_control: The clockwork register projector must accept only already-materialized evidence object identities; until adoption, verify every new evidence path exists before invoking the canonical generator.

incidents.expected_invariant: A tranche plan test must bind the immutable opening receipt to its exact source while validating the mutable live latch structurally across later candidate and successor transitions.

correction.prevention_control: The clockwork must distinguish immutable event receipts from mutable current projections; historical tests bind the former exactly and validate the latter by schema, operation identity when applicable and terminal invariants rather than predecessor literals.

incidents.detection_method: The five-module post-transition packet passed 64 checks and failed only the historical operation_id assertion in the generic mutable-latch continuity test; inspection also aligned the terminal reason with the canonical operation_complete projection.

correction.action: Preserve explicit assertions for recognised immutable historical transitions, replace the fallback historical operation literal with schema-valid completed-state structure, use the canonical operation_complete terminal reason, record AER-0600 and rerun the focused transition plus integrated packets.
correction.prevention_control: The shadow clockwork projector must generate the mutable current-latch check from the terminal event schema; tests may bind exact operation facts only through immutable event receipts, never through the fallback branch for live state.

incidents.expected_invariant: related_incident_ids may link only valid peer incidents within the same attempt; recurrence is represented solely by recurrence_signature and its derived pattern report.
incidents.observed_error: Rejected revision 519 linked AER-0600 to AER-0599 through related_incident_ids even though they have different attempt identities, so canonical validation failed before pattern generation.

incidents.observed_error: The first inherited command repeated the incompatible provider-free wrapper and failed with localappdata_missing in two deterministic checks.
incidents.detection_method: The wrapper emitted only the typed local resource guard failures and native-process count remained zero.

correction.action: Use the predecessor-approved no-conftest pytest invocation for the exact selected inherited tests.
correction.prevention_control: Verifier environment constraints are inherited as typed command-selection inputs across descendant closeouts.

incidents.expected_invariant: The source reader copies the exact accepted installed package-seed root from the materialisation lineage rather than inferring it from another cache convention.
incidents.observed_error: The first reader inferred AppData/Local/emr4-native-harness from the separate npm-cache convention while the accepted seed is under the user profile's .cache/emr4-native-harness path.
incidents.detection_method: Five focused assertions and deterministic --check failed closed at source_root_missing_or_unsafe before source admission, output publication or a native process.

correction.action: Bind the accepted user-profile .cache package-seed root in the reader and focused tests.
correction.prevention_control: Descendant source readers copy package-seed locations from the accepted materialisation owner and never infer them from another cache's environment convention.

incidents.expected_invariant: A clockwork graph node uses the schema-supported empty contract_evidence form unless it supplies the required structured object.
incidents.observed_error: The first closeout intent supplied contract_evidence as a path list, which the prospective source-graph validator rejected as contract_evidence_object_required.
incidents.detection_method: Clockwork --check rejected tick_transaction_prepare before command execution, generation, publication or canonical mutation.

correction.action: Use the supported empty contract_evidence form and retain the contract path in the artifact list.
correction.prevention_control: Closeout authors copy contract_evidence shape from the live graph schema or an accepted non-empty exemplar and rely on clockwork --check before publication.

incidents.expected_invariant: The exact physical rc.7 package source path is copied from the accepted predecessor contract and is not inferred from a logical evidence binding.
incidents.observed_error: The first source lookup appended the logical evidence path directly to the cache root and omitted the package-seed/node_modules/@deepseek-ai segments.
incidents.detection_method: The read-only lookup returned path absence before source admission or process execution.

correction.action: Resolve the physical seed path from the accepted predecessor contract before reading the pinned source.
correction.prevention_control: Descendant source readers copy the full physical path from the accepted source-owning contract.

incidents.expected_invariant: Plan prose assertions compare normalized document text where Markdown line wrapping is non-semantic.
incidents.observed_error: The first focused assertion searched raw Markdown for a phrase split by line wrapping.
incidents.detection_method: Pytest failed before Node execution.

correction.action: Normalize whitespace before plan prose assertions.
correction.prevention_control: Use one normalized document reading for non-format-sensitive prose assertions.

incidents.expected_invariant: A representation-level correction is applied consistently to all adjacent assertions sharing the same source representation.
incidents.observed_error: The first correction normalized only the failing assertion and left the adjacent null-detail assertion on raw text.
incidents.detection_method: The next pytest run failed on the adjacent assertion before Node execution.

correction.action: Use one normalized reading for every plan-prose assertion.
correction.prevention_control: When a source representation rule changes, audit the full local assertion family before rerun.

incidents.expected_invariant: The controller retains a typed process envelope before interpreting a fixture result, and reports only observed numeric exits.
incidents.observed_error: Attempt 001 embedded an all-or-nothing vector self-check while the controller retained neither vector nor process envelope; the orchestrator later described source-defined exit 2 as observed.
incidents.detection_method: Post-attempt evidence review found only the outer node_fixture_exit_nonzero terminal and no retained numeric exit.

correction.action: Correct the attempt record to numeric-exit unobserved and move semantic vector checking into Python after process-envelope retention.
correction.prevention_control: Never state a numeric process exit unless it is present in typed machine evidence.

incidents.expected_invariant: The controller retains numeric exit and content-free stream measurements before any semantic admission branch.
incidents.observed_error: Attempt 002 checked nonzero exit before retaining numeric exit or stream sizes, leaving another outer-only terminal.
incidents.detection_method: The consumed attempt record contained node_fixture_exit_nonzero but no process envelope.

correction.action: Record numeric exit, byte counts and digests before semantic admission in attempt 003.
correction.prevention_control: Every governed child process writes a content-free envelope before success or failure interpretation.

incidents.expected_invariant: A local Windows Node fixture receives the minimum operating-system environment needed by the resolved executable without inheriting ambient secrets.
incidents.observed_error: All three sanitizer fixture processes used env={}; attempt 003 returned exit 134 with zero stdout and 715 stderr bytes.
incidents.detection_method: Source comparison with the accepted repository Node fixture convention and the typed attempt-003 process envelope.

correction.action: Freeze a separate one-process successor that supplies only SystemRoot, WINDIR, ComSpec, TEMP and TMP while preserving sanitizer/wrapper hashes.
correction.prevention_control: Windows child launch envelopes use an explicitly reviewed minimum-key projection and never an unexplained empty or full ambient environment.

incidents.expected_invariant: Negative-evidence tests bind exact authored plan language instead of inventing equivalent prose.
incidents.observed_error: The first test asserted an invented phrase, Exactly one successor process, rather than the plan's authored wording.
incidents.detection_method: Pytest rejected the mismatch during closeout verification.

correction.action: Bind the normalized exact phrase one local Node process in this successor.
correction.prevention_control: Copy source-owned wording into evidence tests after normalizing only non-semantic whitespace.

incidents.expected_invariant: Closeout incident observations use only the validator's closed candidate-state, severity, workflow-disposition, category, stage and correction-status vocabularies.
incidents.observed_error: The first intent used descriptive labels including uncommitted_candidate, committed_failed_candidate and medium outside the closed incident vocabulary.
incidents.detection_method: Clockwork --check rejected tick_incident_candidate_state before command execution, generation, publication or canonical mutation.

correction.action: Replace every descriptive incident label with a validator-enumerated value and record the rejection in the same atomic closeout.
correction.prevention_control: Read and copy the live incident enum values before authoring a closeout observation; rely on clockwork --check before command execution or publication.

incidents.expected_invariant: The prospective register revision is the canonical predecessor revision plus one atomic projection, independent of the number of incident observations in that projection.
incidents.observed_error: After adding the eighth observation, the intent advanced the prospective register path from revision 605 to 606 instead of retaining revision 605 and increasing only the incident count.
incidents.detection_method: Clockwork --check rejected tick_incident_revision_path before command execution, generation, publication or canonical mutation.

correction.action: Keep the prospective register at revision 605 and advance the incident count from 880 by the exact nine observations.
correction.prevention_control: Derive revision as canonical revision plus one projection and derive incident count separately as canonical count plus observation count.

incidents.expected_invariant: A failing cached-diff whitespace check stops the command sequence before commit.
incidents.observed_error: The PowerShell sequence did not inspect LASTEXITCODE after git diff --cached --check, so four EOF blank-line warnings were followed by a local commit.
incidents.detection_method: The command output showed the four warnings immediately before the successful local commit summary.

correction.action: Remove the four EOF blank lines in an explicit-path follow-up commit and guard the final whitespace check exit before push.
correction.prevention_control: Every multi-command verification/commit or verification/push sequence checks LASTEXITCODE and exits before the state-changing command.
